title: PRE-ABLATION SERUM BIOMARKERS ASSOCIATED WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION RECURRENCE: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS TO IMPROVE PATIENT SELECTION FOR CATHETER ABLATION
summary: Atrial fibrillation is a common arrhythmia whose recurrence after ablation may be predicted by serum biomarkers, highlighting the need to consolidate evidence to improve patient selection. The objective was to identify pre-ablation serum biomarkers associated with atrial fibrillation recurrence after catheter ablation. A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted according to the PRISMA guidelines, with searches performed in PubMed, Embase, and Scopus using the descriptors “Catheter Ablation,” “Biomarkers,” and “Atrial Fibrillation,” combined with the Boolean operators AND/OR. Thirty studies were included, most of which demonstrated good methodological quality. Inflammatory biomarkers and composite scores showed promising results, whereas clinical factors, ablation strategies, pharmacological interventions, technical aspects, and risk and artificial intelligence models showed heterogeneous findings. The findings indicated the potential of biomarkers and predictive tools to improve recurrence risk stratification. However, pre-ablation serum biomarkers, combined with clinical factors and predictive models, may assist in patient selection and individualized management for ablation, although the heterogeneity of the evidence requires validation in multicenter studies.

AI.tldr: 本系统综述与荟萃分析纳入30项研究，发现炎症生物标志物和复合评分与房颤消融术后复发相关，但证据异质性大，需多中心验证。
AI.motivation: 房颤消融术后复发预测缺乏可靠指标，血清生物标志物有望改善患者选择，但既往证据分散，需系统评价整合。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，遵循PRISMA指南，检索PubMed、Embase和Scopus，纳入30项研究，评估消融前血清生物标志物与房颤复发关联，多数研究质量良好。
AI.result: 炎症生物标志物和复合评分显示较好预测价值，而临床因素、消融策略、药物干预、技术因素及风险与人工智能模型结果异质。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 消融前血清生物标志物联合临床因素和预测模型可能辅助患者选择和个体化管理，但证据异质性高，需多中心研究验证。

title: Circulating osteoprotegerin levels in atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a common arrhythmia associated with stroke, heart failure, and adverse cardiovascular outcomes. Beyond electrical instability, AF is linked to inflammatory, fibrotic, vascular, and metabolic remodeling. Osteoprotegerin (OPG), a soluble decoy receptor within the RANK/RANKL pathway, has emerged as a cardiovascular biomarker and may reflect adverse atrial substrate or systemic cardiovascular risk. However, studies evaluating circulating OPG in AF have been small and heterogeneous. We aimed to synthesize circulating OPG levels in AF and clinically defined comparator populations. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies reporting circulating OPG concentrations in adults with AF and eligible comparator populations. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were searched from database inception through 5 August 2026. Only English-language reports were eligible. Trial registries were not searched, and study authors were not contacted for unpublished or additional data. Random-effects models estimated pooled mean OPG concentrations within clinically and analytically defined strata using restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimation with Hartung-Knapp adjustment. Analyses were stratified by clinical category, biological matrix, and reported unit. Heterogeneity was assessed using I 2 , τ 2 , and 95% prediction intervals where available. Thirty-five publications were included in the final evidence set. In the AF plasma pmol/L stratum, four study arms yielded a pooled mean OPG concentration of 6.47 pmol/L (95% CI, 5.12 to 7.82; 95% prediction interval, 3.50 to 9.44; I 2 = 95.4%; τ 2 = 0.6882; p < 0.0001). Conventional control strata were also heterogeneous, including plasma pmol/L 3.27 (95% CI, 2.59 to 3.94; I 2 = 83.1%) and serum pmol/L 4.47 (95% CI, 3.54 to 5.40; I 2 = 98.0%). Garnier 2022 contributed single-study plasma pg/mL estimates for AFDAS and post-stroke sinus rhythm. Other control and clinical-comparator strata also showed substantial heterogeneity. Circulating OPG concentrations can be estimated within selected AF and comparator strata, but the available evidence does not support a single universal AF-versus-control effect or a diagnostic threshold. Substantial heterogeneity limits direct clinical interpretation. Larger standardized studies are needed to clarify whether OPG predicts AF onset, recurrence, or adverse outcomes and whether it adds value beyond established clinical risk scores.

AI.tldr: 该系统评价纳入35篇文献，房颤患者血浆OPG合并均值约6.47 pmol/L，但异质性极高（I²=95.4%），现有证据不支持统一的房颤与对照比较效应或诊断阈值。
AI.motivation: 房颤除电活动不稳定外，还涉及炎症、纤维化、血管与代谢重构。OPG是RANK/RANKL通路中的可溶性诱饵受体，被视为心血管生物标志物，可能反映不良心房基质或全身心血管风险；但既往评估房颤患者循环OPG的研究样本量小且异质性大，缺乏系统汇总。
AI.method: 系统评价与meta分析。检索PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus和Cochrane Library（建库至2026年8月5日），仅纳入英文报告，未检索试验注册库、未联系作者获取未发表数据。纳入报告成人房颤及合格对照人群循环OPG浓度的研究，最终纳入35篇文献。采用随机效应模型，按临床类别、生物基质和报告单位分层，用REML估计并作Hartung-Knapp校正，合并各层平均OPG浓度；以I²、τ²及95%预测区间评估异质性。
AI.result: 房颤血浆pmol/L层共4个研究臂，合并平均OPG为6.47 pmol/L（95%CI 5.12–7.82；95%预测区间3.50–9.44；I²=95.4%；τ²=0.6882；P<0.0001）。常规对照层同样异质：血浆pmol/L为3.27（95%CI 2.59–3.94；I²=83.1%），血清pmol/L为4.47（95%CI 3.54–5.40；I²=98.0%）。Garnier 2022单研究提供房颤相关卒中（AFDAS）及卒中后窦性心律的血浆pg/mL估计值。其他对照及临床比较层亦显示显著异质性。
AI.conclusion: 循环OPG浓度可在特定房颤及对照分层内估计，但现有证据不支持统一的房颤与对照比较效应或诊断阈值，显著异质性限制直接临床解读。尚需更大规模标准化研究明确OPG能否预测房颤发生、复发或不良结局，以及是否在既有临床风险评分之外提供增量价值。

title: Cardiac-Net: A Wearable ECG Prototype and Hybrid CNN–Transformer Model for Atrial Fibrillation Detection in Long-Term ECG Recordings
summary: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is a leading cause of stroke and mortality after cardiac surgery, motivating continuous long-term ECG monitoring.This paper presents Cardiac-Net, a wearable ECG system (ESP32-S3/AD8232 BLE device with a Flutter mobile gateway; 128 Hz nominal/85 Hz effective BLE sampling rate, 12.6 ms mean latency, zero over-the-air loss of transmitted packets, 3.11 mJ per transmitted sample) combined with a hybrid 1D CNN–Transformer classifier and a proposed cloud-assisted monitoring architecture; the cloud inference and monitoring-dashboard layer is a design-level proposal only and has not been implemented. Bench signal fidelity, validated against a BIOPAC MP36 reference using a Fluke ProSim 8 simulator across five noise conditions, yields a Pearson Correlation Coefficient of 0.9222 and BPM errors below 0.2% under clean conditions, within the 5% heart-rate-error threshold specified by IEC 60601-2-47. The classifier was trained and evaluated on the Long-Term Atrial Fibrillation Database (84 recordings) using a record-wise (patient-wise) data split with verified zero overlap between training, validation, and test recordings; 5-fold record-wise cross-validation spanning all 84 recordings yields AUC =0.953±0.016, F1 =0.894±0.030, precision =0.880±0.051, and recall =0.915±0.073; re-evaluating at the device’s actual 85 Hz effective throughput confirms comparable discrimination (AUC =0.946±0.010) alongside a real increase in false-alarm burden. A clinical evaluation protocol beyond segment-level accuracy shows that most AF episodes are detected (episode-level sensitivity 0.839±0.222 by fold; per-patient median 1.000, IQR [0.925, 1.000]), but this is not uniform across patients: 7.2% (6/83) fall below chance-level detection. Combined with a false-alarm burden of 86±38 alerts per patient-day and a prevalence-adjusted positive predictive value of only 0.28–0.44 at 5–10% assumed AF prevalence, alarm calibration and patient-level reliability both remain barriers to unsupervised clinical deployment. Zero-shot evaluation on the independent MIT-BIH Atrial Fibrillation Database, with no fine-tuning, yields an ensemble AUC of 0.834, indicating generalization beyond the training distribution alongside a measurable domain gap. Post-hoc Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients attributions are consistent with physiologically grounded decision-making, concentrating on RR-interval irregularity and QRS morphology. Cardiac-Net thus contributes a validated wearable acquisition layer and a rigorously, record-wise cross-validated detection model, together with an honest characterization of the false-alarm and calibration challenges that remain before postoperative clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: Cardiac-Net可穿戴心电系统联合混合CNN-Transformer模型在长程心电中检测房颤，记录级交叉验证AUC 0.953，但误报负担高且部分患者检测失败，临床部署仍需优化。
AI.motivation: 术后房颤是心脏手术后卒中和死亡的主要原因，需要连续长程心电监测。现有可穿戴设备与检测算法在信号保真度、患者级泛化性和误报控制方面证据不足，本研究旨在开发并验证一套可穿戴心电采集系统与深度学习分类器。
AI.method: 研究为原型系统开发与算法验证。可穿戴设备基于ESP32-S3/AD8232，蓝牙标称采样率128 Hz、有效85 Hz，平均延迟12.6 ms，传输零丢包，每样本能耗3.11 mJ。分类器为1D CNN-Transformer混合模型，在Long-Term AF Database的84条记录上训练和评估，采用记录级（患者级）数据划分确保零重叠，进行5折记录级交叉验证。主要终点为AUC、F1、精确率、召回率；次要终点包括片段级和 episode 级灵敏度、误报负担、阳性预测值及零样本泛化性能。
AI.result: 5折记录级交叉验证：AUC 0.953±0.016，F1 0.894±0.030，精确率0.880±0.051，召回率0.915±0.073；在设备实际85 Hz有效采样率下AUC 0.946±0.010，但误报负担增加。片段级评估显示多数AF episode可检出（episode级灵敏度0.839±0.222，患者中位数1.000，IQR 0.925-1.000），但7.2%（6/83）患者低于随机水平。误报负担为每患者日86±38次警报，在5-10%假定AF患病率下阳性预测值仅0.28-0.44。零样本在MIT-BIH AF Database上集成AUC 0.834。Grad-CAM和Integrated Gradients归因集中于RR间期不规则性和QRS形态。
AI.conclusion: Cardiac-Net提供了经过验证的可穿戴采集层和严格记录级交叉验证的检测模型，但高误报负担和患者级校准问题仍是术后临床部署前的主要障碍，需进一步优化警报校准和个体化可靠性。

summary_zh: 术后心房颤动（POAF）是心脏手术后卒中和死亡的主要原因，这促使了连续长期心电监测的需求。本文介绍了Cardiac-Net，一种可穿戴心电系统（ESP32-S3/AD8232 BLE设备，配有Flutter移动网关；标称128 Hz/有效85 Hz的BLE采样率，平均延迟12.6 ms，传输数据包空中零丢失，每个传输样本能耗3.11 mJ），结合混合1D CNN–Transformer分类器和提出的云辅助监测架构；云推理和监测仪表板层仅为设计级提案，尚未实施。台架信号保真度，使用Fluke ProSim 8模拟器在五种噪声条件下针对BIOPAC MP36参考进行验证，得出Pearson相关系数为0.9222，在干净条件下BPM误差低于0.2%，处于IEC 60601-2-47规定的5%心率误差阈值之内。分类器在长期心房颤动数据库（84条记录）上进行了训练和评估，采用按记录（按患者）的数据划分，并验证了训练、验证和测试记录之间零重叠；覆盖所有84条记录的5折按记录交叉验证得出AUC=0.953±0.016，F1=0.894±0.030，精确率=0.880±0.051，召回率=0.915±0.073；在设备实际85 Hz有效吞吐量下重新评估，确认了可比的区分度（AUC=0.946±0.010），同时假警报负担确实增加。超越片段级准确性的临床评估方案显示，大多数AF发作被检测到（按折的发作级灵敏度0.839±0.222；每患者中位数1.000，IQR [0.925, 1.000]），但这在患者间并不均匀：7.2%（6/83）低于机会水平检测。结合每患者日86±38次警报的假警报负担和在5–10%假定AF患病率下仅0.28–0.44的患病率调整阳性预测值，警报校准和患者级可靠性仍是无人监督临床部署的障碍。在独立的MIT-BIH心房颤动数据库上进行零样本评估，无需微调，得出集成AUC为0.834，表明在训练分布之外具有泛化性，同时存在可测量的领域差距。事后Grad-CAM和Integrated Gradients归因与生理学基础的决策一致，集中在RR间期不规则性和QRS形态上。因此，Cardiac-Net贡献了一个经过验证的可穿戴采集层和一个严格按记录交叉验证的检测模型，并诚实描述了术后临床部署前仍存在的假警报和校准挑战。

title: Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Medical Therapy in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The use of anticoagulation in patients with atrial fibrillation is often limited by the significant risk of bleeding, and difficulties maintaining consistent adherence over time. These challenges have led to the development of left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) as an alternative stroke prevention strategy in this patient population. Our study aimed to evaluate LAAC versus medical therapy in patients with atrial fibrillation.

METHODS: A comprehensive search was conducted using PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library from database inception through April 1, 2026. The predefined endpoints were composite outcome of systemic embolism, cardiovascular mortality, or stroke in addition to other endpoints including all-cause mortality, cardiovascular mortality, strokes, and major bleeding. All outcomes were pooled using a random effect Mantel-Haenszel model. The between-study variance (τ2) was estimated using the Paul Mendel method, which is the preferred method when the number of included studies is small.

RESULTS: A total of five randomized controlled trials, 5,404 patients were analyzed; 2,878 underwent LAAC and 2,526 received medical therapy. The median follow-up across studies was 4 years. LAAC met noninferiority compared with medical therapy in atrial fibrillation for major bleeding (RR 0.86; 95% CI 0.59-1.26) and all-cause mortality (RR 0.93; 95% CI 0.71-1.22). In contrast, noninferiority was not met for the composite outcome (RR 0.97; 95% CI 0.64-1.47), cardiovascular mortality (RR 0.86; 95% CI 0.51-1.42), systemic embolism (RR 1.93; 95% CI 0.21-17.5), and all stroke (RR 1.11; 95% CI 0.73-1.67).

CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis showed that LAAC was noninferior to anticoagulation for all-cause mortality and major bleeding, but it did not meet noninferiority for the other assessed outcomes, including stroke, cardiovascular mortality, and/or systemic embolism.

AI.tldr: 纳入5项RCT共5404例房颤患者的荟萃分析显示，左心耳封堵在全因死亡和大出血方面不劣于药物治疗，但在卒中、心血管死亡及系统性栓塞等终点未达到非劣效。
AI.motivation: 房颤患者长期抗凝受出血风险高、依从性难以维持等因素限制，左心耳封堵（LAAC）作为替代性卒中预防策略逐渐应用于临床，但其相对药物治疗在硬终点上的疗效与安全性仍缺乏系统整合的随机对照证据，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library自建库至2026年4月1日的文献。纳入5项随机对照试验，共5404例房颤患者，其中2878例接受LAAC、2526例接受药物治疗，中位随访4年。预设终点包括系统性栓塞、心血管死亡或卒中的复合终点，以及全因死亡、心血管死亡、卒中和主要出血。采用随机效应Mantel-Haenszel模型合并效应量，以Paul Mendel法估计研究间方差τ2。
AI.result: LAAC对比药物治疗：主要出血RR 0.86（95%CI 0.59-1.26）、全因死亡RR 0.93（95%CI 0.71-1.22），达到非劣效；复合终点RR 0.97（95%CI 0.64-1.47）、心血管死亡RR 0.86（95%CI 0.51-1.42）、系统性栓塞RR 1.93（95%CI 0.21-17.5）、全部卒中RR 1.11（95%CI 0.73-1.67），均未达到非劣效。摘要未报告各终点的具体P值。
AI.conclusion: 在房颤患者中，LAAC在全因死亡和主要出血方面不劣于抗凝药物治疗，但在卒中、心血管死亡及系统性栓塞等终点未证实非劣效，提示LAAC不能简单替代药物治疗，临床决策需结合患者出血与栓塞风险个体化权衡。本研究仅纳入5项RCT、部分终点事件数少致置信区间宽泛，结论需更大样本和更长随访验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动患者抗凝治疗的使用常因显著的出血风险以及难以长期维持一致依从性而受限。这些挑战促使左心耳封堵（LAAC）作为该患者人群的替代性卒中预防策略得以发展。本研究旨在评估心房颤动患者中LAAC与药物治疗的比较。

方法：使用PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library从数据库建库至2026年4月1日进行了全面检索。预设终点为系统性栓塞、心血管死亡或卒中的复合结局，以及其他终点包括全因死亡、心血管死亡、卒中和重大出血。所有结局均采用随机效应Mantel-Haenszel模型进行合并。研究间方差（τ2）采用Paul Mendel法估计，该方法在纳入研究数量较少时为首选方法。

结果：共分析5项随机对照试验、5,404例患者；2,878例接受LAAC，2,526例接受药物治疗。研究的中位随访时间为4年。在心房颤动患者中，LAAC在重大出血（RR 0.86；95% CI 0.59-1.26）和全因死亡（RR 0.93；95% CI 0.71-1.22）方面达到非劣效于药物治疗。相反，复合结局（RR 0.97；95% CI 0.64-1.47）、心血管死亡（RR 0.86；95% CI 0.51-1.42）、系统性栓塞（RR 1.93；95% CI 0.21-17.5）和所有卒中（RR 1.11；95% CI 0.73-1.67）未达到非劣效性。

结论：本荟萃分析显示，LAAC在全因死亡和重大出血方面非劣效于抗凝治疗，但在其他评估结局（包括卒中、心血管死亡和/或系统性栓塞）方面未达到非劣效性。

title: Pre-excited atrial fibrillation in a woman with minimal pre-excitation: a case report
summary: Introduction: A 46-year-old Thai woman presented with palpitation. A 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) showed rapid rate of preexcited atrial fibrillation (AF). The subsequent ECG after electrical cardioversion demonstrated minimal preexcitation with short PR interval, and apparently small delta waves only in leads II, III, V4, and V5. An electrophysiologic study was performed and showed sinus rhythm with short H-V interval compatible with preexcitation. A programmed electrical stimulation showed orthodromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia utilizing left lateral accessory pathway. The catheter ablation was successfully performed via retrograde aortic approach to left lateral accessory pathway. There was no recurrence of Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) ECG pattern, supraventricular tachycardia, or AF during 3-month follow-up visit. Conclusion: This is a rare case of minimal preexcitation presenting with preexcited AF as first presentation. This case reflects minimal preexcitation does not indicate low risk of ventricular fibrillation and sudden cardiac arrest.

AI.tldr: 46岁泰国女性以预激性房颤为首发表现，电复律后仅见微小预激，电生理检查证实左外侧旁路并成功消融，提示微小预激并不代表低危。
AI.motivation: 微小预激（minimal pre-excitation）在体表心电图上表现不明显，临床常被低估其风险；既往证据多关注显性预激，缺乏对微小预激合并预激性房颤的病例认识，本研究通过个案报道提示其潜在致命风险。
AI.method: 个案报道。对象为46岁泰国女性，因心悸就诊，12导联心电图示快速预激性房颤，电复律后心电图示短PR间期及仅II、III、V4、V5导联可见小delta波。行电生理检查及程序电刺激，明确旁路定位后经逆行主动脉途径行导管消融。终点为消融成功及随访3个月无WPW心电图模式、室上性心动过速或房颤复发。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 电生理检查示窦性心律伴短H-V间期，符合预激；程序电刺激诱发顺向型房室折返性心动过速，证实左外侧旁路。经逆行主动脉途径成功消融左外侧旁路。随访3个月无WPW心电图模式、室上性心动过速或房颤复发。摘要未报告具体H-V间期、旁路有效不应期等数值。
AI.conclusion: 本例为微小预激以预激性房颤为首发表现的罕见病例，提示微小预激并不意味着室颤和心脏性猝死风险低。临床对短PR间期伴微小delta波者应提高警惕，必要时行电生理检查评估旁路风险；但本结论基于单例报道，尚需更大样本验证。

summary_zh: 引言：一名46岁泰国女性因心悸就诊。12导联心电图（ECG）显示快速心室率的预激性心房颤动（AF）。电复律后的后续心电图显示微小预激，表现为短PR间期，且仅在II、III、V4和V5导联可见貌似小的delta波。进行了电生理检查，显示窦性心律伴短H-V间期，符合预激。程序电刺激显示利用左侧游离壁旁路的顺向性房室折返性心动过速。通过逆行主动脉途径对左侧游离壁旁路成功进行了导管消融。在3个月的随访期间，未出现Wolff-Parkinson-White（WPW）心电图模式、室上性心动过速或AF的复发。结论：这是一例罕见的以预激性AF为首发表现的微小预激病例。该病例反映微小预激并不意味着心室颤动和心脏骤停的风险低。

title: Tricuspid Stenosis Due to Cardiac Sarcoma.
summary: Primary cardiac sarcomas are rare, aggressive malignant tumors with high recurrence rates and poor prognosis. Their initial presentation is often vague, contributing to diagnostic delay and rapid clinical deterioration. We report the case of a 32-year-old man who presented with gastrointestinal symptoms and constitutional features, initially suggesting a hepatobiliary or infectious cause. As his condition progressed, signs of right-sided heart failure emerged, prompting transthoracic echocardiography, which revealed a large right atrial mass causing tricuspid inflow obstruction and a significant pericardial effusion. Surgical resection confirmed biphasic synovial sarcoma, a subtype previously described in small case series. Despite an initially uncomplicated postoperative course, he subsequently developed atrial flutter with associated left ventricular dysfunction, necessitating cardioversion. Anthracycline toxicity remains a possible contributing factor. This case underscores the importance of maintaining a broad differential diagnosis in young patients with unexplained systemic symptoms and highlights the diagnostic value of early echocardiographic assessment when right-sided cardiac involvement is suspected. It also reinforces the need for multidisciplinary management given the tumor's aggressive behavior and potential for rapid clinical decline.

AI.tldr: 32岁男性原发性心脏双相滑膜肉瘤致三尖瓣流入道梗阻，术后出现心房扑动及左室功能不全，需电复律。
AI.motivation: 原发性心脏肉瘤罕见、侵袭性强、复发率高且预后差，早期表现模糊常致诊断延迟；本文通过一例以胃肠道及全身症状起病、后出现右心衰竭的年轻患者，提示对不明原因全身症状者应扩大鉴别诊断并早期行超声心动图评估。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。患者为32岁男性，初诊以胃肠道症状及全身症状为主，疑肝胆或感染性疾病；病情进展出现右心衰竭征象后行经胸超声心动图，发现右心房巨大占位致三尖瓣流入道梗阻并伴大量心包积液；经手术切除病理确诊为双相滑膜肉瘤。摘要未报告样本量以外的统计方法及终点定义。
AI.result: 超声心动图显示右心房巨大占位导致三尖瓣流入道梗阻及显著心包积液；手术切除后病理证实为双相滑膜肉瘤。术后初期病程平稳，但随后出现心房扑动并伴左心室功能不全，需行电复律；蒽环类药物毒性被认为是可能的促发因素。摘要未报告具体心功能数值、扑动发作时间及随访结局。
AI.conclusion: 本例提示年轻患者出现不明原因全身症状时应警惕原发性心脏肿瘤，早期超声心动图对怀疑右心受累者具有重要诊断价值；肿瘤侵袭性强、病情可迅速恶化，需多学科协作管理。局限性为单例报告，无法推断发生率或疗效，术后心律失常与蒽环类毒性的关系尚待进一步研究。

summary_zh: 原发性心脏肉瘤是罕见的侵袭性恶性肿瘤，复发率高且预后差。其初始表现常不明确，导致诊断延迟和临床状况迅速恶化。我们报告一例32岁男性，表现为胃肠道症状和全身性特征，最初提示肝胆或感染性病因。随着病情进展，出现右心衰竭体征，促使进行经胸超声心动图检查，发现一个大的右心房肿块导致三尖瓣流入道梗阻和显著的心包积液。手术切除证实为双相型滑膜肉瘤，该亚型此前仅在小病例系列中描述过。尽管术后初期病程平稳，但随后出现心房扑动伴相关左心室功能障碍，需要心脏复律。蒽环类药物的毒性仍是可能的促进因素。本病例强调了对有不明原因全身症状的年轻患者保持广泛鉴别诊断的重要性，并突出了当怀疑右侧心脏受累时早期超声心动图评估的诊断价值。鉴于该肿瘤的侵袭性行为和临床状况快速恶化的可能性，本病例也强调了多学科管理的必要性。

title: The Impact of Energy Drinks on the Genesis of Cardiac Arrhythmias: A Narrative Review
summary: This narrative review aims to synthesize research on energy drink use and the development of arrhythmias among healthy individuals without preexisting conditions.A special focus is given to the electrocardiogram (EKG) following beverage consumption.A literature search was conducted on the Web of Science, Embase, Medline, and Cochrane databases for original, peer-reviewed studies that reported EKG findings following energy drink consumption.Secondary research and studies that had subjects with preexisting cardiac conditions were excluded.Ten controlled experimental studies and seven case reports met the inclusion criteria.Currently available evidence from controlled experimental studies involved one-time, one-day intake of energy drinks.Beverages varied in volume, content, and consumption rates across studies.Some acute EKG changes, including prolongation of the corrected QT (QTc) interval, have been reported in prospective studies in relation to energy drinks.However, no clinically significant arrhythmias were recorded.Although the studies in this review suggest that limited use of energy drinks is unlikely to cause an arrhythmia in healthy individuals, their arrhythmogenic potential cannot be ruled out.Case reports related to otherwise healthy individuals demonstrate a potential relationship between energy drink usage and the development of atrial fibrillation, especially with the co-ingestion of alcohol.The presence of confounding factors in these case reports makes it unclear whether energy drinks alone, or with the presence of additional triggers, may precipitate an arrhythmia.Future research should focus on energy drink use over time and on the contribution of lifestyle factors to better assess the impact of energy drinks on arrhythmia genesis.

AI.tldr: 健康人群单次饮用能量饮料可致QTc间期延长，但未记录到临床显著心律失常；病例报告提示能量饮料（尤其与酒精同服）可能与房颤发生相关。
AI.motivation: 能量饮料消费日益普遍，但其对健康人群心律失常发生的潜在影响尚不明确，既往证据多为个案或小样本研究，缺乏系统综述。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，检索Web of Science、Embase、Medline和Cochrane数据库，纳入报告能量饮料消费后心电图（EKG）结局的原创同行评议研究，排除二次研究及有基础心脏疾病者。最终纳入10项对照实验研究和7例病例报告。
AI.result: 对照实验研究均涉及单次、单日能量饮料摄入，饮料体积、成分和饮用速度各异。前瞻性研究报告了部分急性EKG改变，包括校正QT（QTc）间期延长，但未记录到临床显著心律失常。病例报告提示能量饮料使用与房颤发生可能存在关联，尤其在与酒精同服时；但混杂因素使能量饮料单独或与其他触发因素共同作用尚不明确。
AI.conclusion: 有限使用能量饮料在健康个体中不太可能引起心律失常，但其致心律失常潜力不能排除。未来需开展长期使用及生活方式因素贡献的研究，以更好评估能量饮料对心律失常发生的影响。

summary_zh: 本叙述性综述旨在综合关于能量饮料使用与无既往疾病的健康个体中心律失常发生的研究。特别关注饮用饮料后的心电图（EKG）。在Web of Science、Embase、Medline和Cochrane数据库上进行了文献检索，寻找报告饮用能量饮料后EKG发现的原创、同行评审研究。排除二次研究以及受试者有既往心脏疾病的研究。十项对照实验研究和七份病例报告符合纳入标准。目前来自对照实验研究的证据涉及一次性、单日摄入能量饮料。各研究中饮料的体积、内容和饮用速度各不相同。前瞻性研究已报告与能量饮料相关的一些急性EKG变化，包括校正QT（QTc）间期延长。然而，未记录到有临床意义的心律失常。尽管本综述中的研究表明，有限使用能量饮料不太可能在健康个体中引起心律失常，但不能排除其致心律失常潜力。与原本健康个体相关的病例报告显示，能量饮料使用与心房颤动的发生之间存在潜在关系，尤其是与酒精共同摄入时。这些病例报告中存在混杂因素，使得不清楚是单独能量饮料还是存在额外触发因素可能促发心律失常。未来研究应关注能量饮料的长期使用以及生活方式因素的影响，以更好地评估能量饮料对心律失常发生的影响。

title: Physical activity, atrial fibrillation and the dose-response relationship: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIM: Regular physical activity (PA) may reduce atrial fibrillation (AF) risk in the general population, however, contemporary data suggests individuals engaging in the highest levels of PA may exhibit a paradoxical rise in AF risk. The point at which the dose-response curve reverses remains unclear. This meta-analysis aimed to assess the association between PA and AF across the full continuum of PA exposure.

METHODS: Four databases were searched (from January 1990 to June 2025). Eligible studies included those that reported PA exposure compared against a sedentary control group and assessed AF incidence or prevalence. PA exposures were standardised to metabolic equivalent of task hours per week (MET-hr/wk). Pooled odds ratios (ORs) were calculated using a weighted random-effects model. A weighted restricted cubic spline model of logarithmic odds was used to produce a dose-response curve.

RESULTS: 37 studies were included (n = 1,298,291 individuals). In the general population, PA was associated with a reduction in odds of AF by 22% (22 studies; OR 0.78; 95% CI 0.68, 0.89). Athlete status was associated with an increase in the odds of AF (15 studies; OR 2.74; 95% CI 1.72, 4.39). Dose-response analysis (26 studies; n = 1,022,790 individuals) showed 26 MET-hr/wk of PA was associated with the greatest reduction in odds of AF, with doses beyond 78 MET-hr/wk associated with increased odds of AF; the equivalent of 6-7 hours per week of endurance training.

CONCLUSION: PA and AF demonstrate a U-shaped relationship whereby beyond a quantitative dose threshold of 78 MET-hr/wk, the protective effect of exercise may reverse.

AI.tldr: 体力活动与房颤风险呈U型关系，每周26 MET-hr时风险最低，超过78 MET-hr（约6-7小时耐力训练）风险反而增加。
AI.motivation: 既往证据提示规律体力活动可能降低房颤风险，但近期数据显示极高强度活动者房颤风险反而升高，剂量反应曲线的反转点尚不明确，本研究旨在评估全范围体力活动暴露与房颤的关联。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索4个数据库（1990年1月至2025年6月），纳入报告体力活动暴露并与久坐对照组比较、评估房颤发病率或患病率的研究。体力活动标准化为每周代谢当量小时（MET-hr/wk）。采用加权随机效应模型计算合并比值比（OR），并用加权限制性立方样条模型拟合对数OR的剂量反应曲线。共纳入37项研究（n=1,298,291）。
AI.result: 在一般人群中，体力活动与房颤风险降低22%相关（22项研究；OR 0.78；95% CI 0.68, 0.89）。运动员状态与房颤风险增加相关（15项研究；OR 2.74；95% CI 1.72, 4.39）。剂量反应分析（26项研究；n=1,022,790）显示，每周26 MET-hr的体力活动与房颤风险降低幅度最大相关，超过78 MET-hr/wk（相当于每周6-7小时耐力训练）则与房颤风险增加相关。
AI.conclusion: 体力活动与房颤呈U型关系，超过78 MET-hr/wk的定量剂量阈值后，运动的保护效应可能反转。这提示临床在推荐运动预防房颤时需考虑剂量上限，对高强度耐力运动人群应加强房颤监测；但本研究为观察性研究的荟萃分析，存在残余混杂可能，且剂量阈值需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：规律的身体活动（PA）可能降低一般人群的心房颤动（AF）风险，然而，当代数据提示，进行最高水平PA的个体可能表现出AF风险的矛盾性升高。剂量-反应曲线发生逆转的拐点仍不明确。本荟萃分析旨在评估在整个PA暴露连续谱中PA与AF之间的关联。

方法：检索了四个数据库（从1990年1月至2025年6月）。符合条件的研究包括那些报告了PA暴露与久坐对照组相比较并评估了AF发病率或患病率的研究。PA暴露被标准化为每周代谢当量任务小时（MET-hr/wk）。使用加权随机效应模型计算汇总比值比（ORs）。使用对数比值比的加权限制性立方样条模型来生成剂量-反应曲线。

结果：共纳入37项研究（n = 1,298,291名个体）。在一般人群中，PA与AF比值降低22%相关（22项研究；OR 0.78；95% CI 0.68, 0.89）。运动员身份与AF比值增加相关（15项研究；OR 2.74；95% CI 1.72, 4.39）。剂量-反应分析（26项研究；n = 1,022,790名个体）显示，26 MET-hr/wk的PA与AF比值最大程度降低相关，而超过78 MET-hr/wk的剂量与AF比值增加相关；相当于每周6-7小时的耐力训练。

结论：PA与AF呈现U形关系，即超过78 MET-hr/wk的定量剂量阈值后，运动的保护效应可能逆转。

title: Effect of Antiarrhythmic Drug Treatment on the Clinical Recurrence Rate of Atrial Arrhythmia Within 90 Days After Primary Pulmonary Vein Isolation
summary: Background This study examines the impact of antiarrhythmic drug treatment on the frequency and timing of clinical atrial arrhythmia recurrence within 90 days postintervention. Methods We retrospectively investigated a control group without antiarrhythmic drug ( n = 50) and a treatment group with antiarrhythmic drug ( n = 50) within the blanking period. Subgroup analysis was based on the pre-interventional heart rhythm (atrial fibrillation or sinus rhythm) and the timing of antiarrhythmic drug initiation. The primary endpoint was the clinical recurrence rate of atrial arrhythmia within 90 days postprimary pulmonary vein isolation. Secondary endpoints included time to first clinical recurrence and recurrence rate in the prespecified subgroups. Results No difference in clinical atrial arrhythmia recurrence rate was observed between the treatment group (32%) and the control group (24%, P = .51) or between the subgroups. First clinical recurrence of atrial arrhythmia occurred earlier in the treatment group (median 12 days (interquartile range 29)) compared to the control group (43 days (interquartile range 46), P = .04). Conclusion There was no difference in the frequency of clinical atrial arrhythmia recurrences in patients with and without antiarrhythmic drugs. However, patients with atrial fibrillation and antiarrhythmic drug treatment started before pulmonary vein isolation showed an earlier first clinical recurrence of atrial arrhythmia.

AI.tldr: 首次肺静脉隔离后90天空白期内，抗心律失常药物未降低临床房性心律失常复发率（32% vs 24%，P=0.51），但治疗组首次复发时间更早（12天 vs 43天，P=0.04）。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离后90天空白期内临床房性心律失常复发常见，抗心律失常药物对该时段复发频率和时机的影响尚不明确，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入100例首次肺静脉隔离患者，分为空白期使用抗心律失常药物治疗组（n=50）和未使用对照组（n=50）。按术前心律（房颤或窦性心律）及抗心律失常药物启动时机进行亚组分析。主要终点为术后90天内临床房性心律失常复发率；次要终点包括首次临床复发时间和预设亚组复发率。
AI.result: 治疗组与对照组临床房性心律失常复发率无差异（32% vs 24%，P=0.51），各亚组间亦无差异。治疗组首次临床复发时间早于对照组（中位12天，四分位距29天 vs 中位43天，四分位距46天，P=0.04）。
AI.conclusion: 抗心律失常药物未减少空白期内临床房性心律失常复发频率，但术前房颤且肺静脉隔离前启动抗心律失常药物治疗的患者首次临床复发更早。该回顾性研究样本量小，结果需前瞻性研究验证，对空白期抗心律失常药物管理策略有提示意义。

summary_zh: 背景：本研究探讨抗心律失常药物治疗对干预后90天内临床房性心律失常复发的频率和时间的影响。方法：我们回顾性研究了空白期内未使用抗心律失常药物的对照组（n = 50）和使用抗心律失常药物的治疗组（n = 50）。亚组分析基于干预前心律（心房颤动或窦性心律）和抗心律失常药物开始使用的时间。主要终点是初次肺静脉隔离后90天内临床房性心律失常的复发率。次要终点包括首次临床复发时间和预设亚组中的复发率。结果：治疗组（32%）与对照组（24%，P = .51）之间或各亚组之间未观察到临床房性心律失常复发率的差异。治疗组首次临床房性心律失常复发发生更早（中位数12天（四分位距29）） compared to 对照组（43天（四分位距46），P = .04）。结论：使用和不使用抗心律失常药物的患者临床房性心律失常复发的频率无差异。然而，心房颤动患者且在肺静脉隔离前开始抗心律失常药物治疗显示首次临床房性心律失常复发更早。

title: Left pulmonary vein re-isolation and unexpected extensive posterior wall isolation with vein of Marshall ethanol infusion after cryoballoon pulmonary vein isolation and roof-line ablation
Quality and Engagement Metrics of Short Versus Long-Form Videos on Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Background Many patients with AF seek online resources for information to understand their condition and treatments.Objective To compare the quality and audience engagement of short- and long-form videos on AF and to determine the correlation between uploader type and audience engagement.Design Cross-sectional studySetting This study was conducted at the Brody School of Medicine of East Carolina University and involved collecting videos using the institution’s resources.Method The research team collected 22 short- and 22 long-form videos from YouTube uploaded since July 2021-October 2024. Two cardiology fellows rated videos using PEMAT to assess viewers’ understandability and actionability and GQS to determine the overall quality of videos. Quality scores and audience engagement were compared by video duration and uploader type.Result The median understandability, actionability and GQS raw scores for shorts were 7 (5,8; maximum: 13), 0 (0,1 maximum: 4) and 2 (1,3 maximum: 5) whereas they were 6.5 (4, 10), 0 (0,0) and 3 (1,4) for regular videos, indicating low understandability, actionability and overall quality.Conclusions We found no significant associations between video duration and quality, or between uploader type and audience engagement, indicating that neither the format nor the uploader type affects the educational content provided in online videos.
journal: Journal of Consumer Health on the Internet

AI.tldr: 在房颤在线视频中，短视频与长视频的可理解性、可行动性和整体质量均较低，且视频时长与质量、上传者类型与受众参与度之间无显著关联。
AI.motivation: 许多房颤患者通过在线视频获取疾病和治疗信息，但短视频与长视频的质量及受众参与度差异，以及上传者类型与参与度的关系尚不明确，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 横断面研究，于东卡罗来纳大学布罗迪医学院收集YouTube上2021年7月至2024年10月上传的22个短视频和22个长视频。由两名心内科研究员使用PEMAT评估可理解性和可行动性，使用GQS评估整体质量。比较不同视频时长和上传者类型的质量评分与受众参与度。
AI.result: 短视频的可理解性、可行动性和GQS中位原始评分分别为7分（5,8；满分13）、0分（0,1；满分4）和2分（1,3；满分5）；长视频分别为6.5分（4,10）、0分（0,0）和3分（1,4），均提示可理解性、可行动性和整体质量较低。视频时长与质量、上传者类型与受众参与度之间均无显著关联（摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI及P值）。
AI.conclusion: 视频格式和上传者类型均不影响房颤在线视频的教育内容质量，但现有视频整体质量偏低。临床医生应关注患者获取的在线信息质量，并考虑制作高质量教育视频；本研究为横断面设计、样本量较小，结论需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 背景：许多房颤（AF）患者在线寻求资源以了解其病情和治疗。目的：比较关于房颤的短视频和长视频的质量和受众参与度，并确定上传者类型与受众参与度之间的相关性。设计：横断面研究。地点：本研究在东卡罗来纳大学布罗迪医学院进行，利用该机构的资源收集视频。方法：研究团队从YouTube收集了2021年7月至2024年10月上传的22个短视频和22个长视频。两名心脏病学研究员使用PEMAT对视频进行评分，以评估观众的可理解性和可操作性，并使用GQS确定视频的整体质量。按视频时长和上传者类型比较质量评分和受众参与度。结果：短视频的可理解性、可操作性和GQS原始评分中位数分别为7（5,8；最高：13）、0（0,1；最高：4）和2（1,3；最高：5），而普通视频分别为6.5（4,10）、0（0,0）和3（1,4），表明可理解性、可操作性和整体质量较低。结论：我们发现视频时长与质量之间，或上传者类型与受众参与度之间没有显著关联，表明格式和上传者类型均不影响在线视频提供的教育内容。

title: Review of Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation as a Therapeutic Approach for the Suppression of Ventricular Premature Contractions
summary: Premature ventricular complexes (PVCs) are among the most frequently encountered forms of cardiac arrhythmias in clinical practice.Their prognostic significance is heterogeneous and is largely determined by the underlying cardiac structure, PVC burden, complexity, and left ventricular function.Frequent or complex PVCs are linked to an elevated risk of adverse cardiovascular outcomes, whereas isolated low-burden PVCs in structurally normal hearts can be benign.Despite the substantial clinical burden imposed by PVCs, the current landscape of therapeutic options remains strikingly limited, often constrained by the adverse effects and variable efficacy of antiarrhythmic drugs, as well as the invasive nature of catheter ablation procedures.In this context, transcutaneous vagus nerve stimulation (tVNS), an innovative and non-invasive neuromodulation technique, has emerged as a promising therapeutic candidate.Through its multifaceted mechanisms of action, including the augmentation of vagal tone, the suppression of excessive sympathetic outflow, and the induction of potent anti-inflammatory effects, tVNS has demonstrated considerable potential in restoring autonomic balance.These compelling mechanistic foundations collectively suggest that tVNS may represent a plausible and novel therapeutic strategy for the effective suppression of PVCs.However, it is important to acknowledge that, while preclinical investigations and early clinical signals have yielded encouraging results, the current body of clinical evidence specifically addressing PVC suppression remains preliminary, heterogeneous, and at times contradictory.This article provides a critical narrative review of the physiological foundations and mechanistic underpinnings of tVNS, synthesizing and critically evaluating preclinical investigations and emerging preliminary clinical data.We aim to appraise the mechanistic rationale, contextualize conflicting clinical trial findings, and critically assess prospective research directions and the practical feasibility of clinical translation.

AI.tldr: 经皮迷走神经刺激（tVNS）通过调节自主神经平衡可能抑制室性早搏（PVC），但现有临床证据尚属初步且异质，需进一步验证。
AI.motivation: 室性早搏（PVC）在临床中常见，高负荷或复杂PVC与不良心血管结局相关，而现有治疗手段有限：抗心律失常药物副作用大且疗效不一，导管消融有创。因此，需要非侵入性新疗法。tVNS作为一种神经调控技术，可能通过增强迷走张力、抑制交感过度激活和抗炎作用恢复自主神经平衡，从而抑制PVC，但临床证据尚不充分。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，批判性评价tVNS的生理学基础和机制，综合临床前研究及初步临床数据，探讨其抑制PVC的机制合理性、临床试验结果的矛盾之处，并评估未来研究方向及临床转化的可行性。摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或样本量。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体的定量结果（如效应量、95%置信区间或P值）。文中指出，临床前研究和早期临床信号显示tVNS具有抑制PVC的潜力，但针对PVC抑制的现有临床证据仍属初步、异质且有时相互矛盾。
AI.conclusion: tVNS可能是一种有前景的非侵入性PVC抑制策略，但当前证据有限且不一致，尚不足以支持临床常规应用。未来需设计严谨的临床试验验证其疗效和安全性，并明确最佳刺激参数和适用人群。

summary_zh: 室性早搏（PVCs）是临床实践中最常见的心律失常形式之一。其预后意义具有异质性，很大程度上取决于潜在的心脏结构、PVC负荷、复杂性以及左心室功能。频繁或复杂的PVC与不良心血管结局风险升高相关，而结构正常心脏中的孤立性低负荷PVC则可能是良性的。尽管PVC带来了沉重的临床负担，当前的治疗选择格局仍显著有限，常受限于抗心律失常药物的不良反应和疗效不一，以及导管消融的侵入性。在此背景下，经皮迷走神经刺激（tVNS）作为一种创新、非侵入性的神经调节技术，已成为有前景的治疗候选。通过其多方面的作用机制，包括增强迷走张力、抑制过度交感输出以及诱导强效抗炎效应，tVNS在恢复自主神经平衡方面已显示出可观潜力。这些有力的机制基础共同提示，tVNS可能代表一种合理且新颖的治疗策略，用于有效抑制PVC。然而，必须承认，尽管临床前研究和早期临床信号已产生令人鼓舞的结果，当前专门针对PVC抑制的临床证据仍处于初步阶段、异质性明显，且有时相互矛盾。本文对tVNS的生理学基础和机制基础进行了批判性叙述性综述，综合并批判性评估了临床前研究和新兴的初步临床数据。我们旨在评价机制合理性、将相互矛盾的临床试验发现置于背景中理解，并批判性评估前瞻性研究方向及临床转化的实际可行性。

title: Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion with the Watchman FLX Device: A Single-Centre Retrospective Analysis of Procedural and One-Year Clinical Outcomes
summary: Background: Left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) is an alternative approach to stroke prevention in selected patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation. This single-centre retrospective study describes device implantation, peri-procedural complications and clinical outcomes during the first year after Watchman FLX implantation. Methods: We analysed 100 consecutive patients who underwent LAAO with the Watchman FLX device at Helios Frankenwaldklinik-Hospital, Kronach, Germany, between 2021 and 2024. The primary endpoint was device implantation success, defined as correct device deployment and implantation. The secondary safety endpoint was a composite of major peri-procedural complications within 72 h. Additional clinical outcomes were strokes and mortality at 30 days and one year. Results: The mean age was 70.7 ± 6.5 years, and 47% of patients were female. The mean CHA2DS2-VASc score was 4.9 ± 1.4, and the mean HAS-BLED score was 4.1 ± 1.0. Device implantation was successful in 100% (95% CI 96.4–100%). The reported peri-procedural complication rate was 7% (95% CI 2.9–13.9%), including major bleeding in 6% (95% CI 2.2–12.6%) and pericardial tamponade in 1% (95% CI 0.0–5.4%). Thirty-day mortality was 2% (95% CI 0.2–7.0%), with no reported strokes (0%; 95% CI 0.0–3.6%). One-year mortality was 11% (95% CI 5.6–18.8%), with one reported stroke (1%; 95% CI 0.0–5.4%). Conclusions: Watchman FLX implantation was achieved in all patients in this cohort. Bleeding was the most frequently reported peri-procedural complication. The low observed stroke proportion should be interpreted alongside the 11% one-year mortality and incomplete imaging surveillance. This uncontrolled descriptive study cannot establish comparative efficacy or comprehensive device safety.

AI.tldr: 单中心100例非瓣膜性房颤患者植入Watchman FLX左心耳封堵器，装置植入成功率100%，围术期并发症7%（大出血6%、心包填塞1%），1年卒中率1%、死亡率11%。
AI.motivation: 左心耳封堵是非瓣膜性房颤患者卒中预防的替代策略，但Watchman FLX这一较新装置在真实世界中的植入成功率、围术期安全性及1年临床结局数据仍有限，尤其缺乏单中心连续病例的详细报告。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2021—2024年德国Helios Frankenwaldklinik-Kronach医院连续100例接受Watchman FLX左心耳封堵的非瓣膜性房颤患者。主要终点为装置植入成功（正确定位与释放）；次要安全终点为72小时内主要围术期并发症复合终点；其他结局包括30天和1年的卒中与死亡。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在本队列中Watchman FLX植入全部成功，出血是最常见的围术期并发症。观察到的低卒中比例需结合11%的1年死亡率和不完整的影像随访解读。该无对照描述性研究无法确立比较疗效或全面装置安全性，尚需对照研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：左心耳封堵（LAAO）是选择性非瓣膜性心房颤动患者卒中预防的替代方法。这项单中心回顾性研究描述了Watchman FLX植入后的器械植入、围术期并发症及术后第一年的临床结局。

方法：我们分析了2021年至2024年间在德国克罗纳赫Helios Frankenwaldklinik医院连续接受Watchman FLX装置LAAO的100例患者。主要终点是器械植入成功，定义为器械正确部署和植入。次要安全终点是72小时内主要围术期并发症的复合终点。其他临床结局是30天和一年的卒中及死亡率。

结果：平均年龄为70.7 ± 6.5岁，47%的患者为女性。平均CHA2DS2-VASc评分为4.9 ± 1.4，平均HAS-BLED评分为4.1 ± 1.0。器械植入成功率为100%（95% CI 96.4–100%）。报告的围术期并发症发生率为7%（95% CI 2.9–13.9%），包括大出血6%（95% CI 2.2–12.6%）和心包填塞1%（95% CI 0.0–5.4%）。30天死亡率为2%（95% CI 0.2–7.0%），未报告卒中（0%；95% CI 0.0–3.6%）。一年死亡率为11%（95% CI 5.6–18.8%），报告一例卒中（1%；95% CI 0.0–5.4%）。

结论：本队列中所有患者均成功植入Watchman FLX。出血是最常报告的围术期并发症。观察到的低卒中比例应结合11%的一年死亡率和影像学监测不完整来解读。这项非对照的描述性研究无法确定比较疗效或全面的器械安全性。

title: Potassium repletion at a serum potassium of 3.3-3.7 mmol/L and new-onset atrial fibrillation in adult ICU patients without cardiac surgery: a pre-registered target trial emulation in MIMIC-IV
summary: Clinicians often give potassium to ICU patients whose serum potassium is low-normal or mildly low, in the belief that this prevents atrial fibrillation (AF). Two randomised trials tested potassium strategies, both after cardiac surgery only: TIGHT-K (JAMA 2024) found that supplementing only below 3.6 mEq/L was noninferior to keeping potassium at or above 4.5 mEq/L, and GRIP-COMPASS found no effect on AF or flutter. Outside cardiac surgery the question is untested, and supplementation thresholds vary between hospitals from 3.3 to 3.9 mmol/L. We will emulate a target trial in MIMIC-IV v3.1. Adults in a non-cardiac-surgery ICU whose first chemistry potassium on the first ICU day is 3.3-3.7 mmol/L will be compared under two strategies: potassium started within 6 hours versus no potassium in those 6 hours. The primary outcome is new AF documented in the ICU within 72 hours. The secondary outcome is death within 28 days.

AI.tldr: 在非心脏手术ICU患者中，血钾3.3-3.7 mmol/L时启动补钾与不补钾的新发AF风险对比，将通过MIMIC-IV目标试验模拟评估。
AI.motivation: 临床常对血钾处于低正常或轻度降低的ICU患者补钾以预防AF，但支持这一做法的随机证据仅来自心脏手术后人群（TIGHT-K显示仅低于3.6 mEq/L补钾不劣于维持≥4.5 mEq/L，GRIP-COMPASS未发现对AF或房扑有效）。非心脏手术ICU人群该问题尚未被检验，且各院补钾阈值在3.3-3.9 mmol/L间差异很大，亟需观察性因果推断证据。
AI.method: 预注册的目标试验模拟研究，数据源为MIMIC-IV v3.1。研究对象为成人非心脏手术ICU患者，纳入标准为入ICU第一日首次血钾3.3-3.7 mmol/L。比较两种策略：6小时内启动补钾 vs 6小时内不补钾。主要终点为72小时内ICU内记录的新发AF，次要终点为28天死亡。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何结果数据（无样本量、效应量、95%CI或P值）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究拟在非心脏手术ICU人群中检验低正常血钾补钾是否降低新发AF，结果尚未公布；若显示无获益，将支持放宽补钾阈值、减少不必要补钾，但作为观察性目标试验模拟存在残余混杂与适应证偏倚的局限，需随机试验验证。

title: Blanking Period after Atrial Fibrillation Catheter Ablation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial arrhythmias that recur within the first 3 months after atrial fibrillation (AF) catheter ablation are conventionally attributed to a "blanking period" and not classified as procedural failure. Accumulating evidence suggests that such early recurrences of atrial tachyarrhythmias (ERAT) may instead predict late recurrence, raising concern that the conventional 3-month window overestimates the duration during which recurrences are benign.

OBJECTIVE: To assess the association between ERAT during each of the first 3 months after AF catheter ablation and late recurrence of atrial tachyarrhythmias (LRAT), and whether this association differs by ablation energy source.

METHODS: We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Embase, and Web of Science without restriction on date or publication status for studies of AF catheter ablation reporting ERAT during defined intervals of the blanking period, stratified by subsequent LRAT status. Ablation energy sources included radiofrequency, cryoballoon, and pulsed field. The exposure was ERAT during the first, second, and third months after ablation, and the outcome was LRAT. Odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled using random-effects models.

RESULTS: Twelve studies comprising 7,751 patients (2,505 with LRAT, 5,246 without) were included. Mean follow-up was 22.0 months, mean age 60.7 years, 25.8% were women, 52.5% had paroxysmal AF, mean CHA2DS2-VASc score was 2.1, mean left atrial diameter 42.6 mm, and mean left ventricular ejection fraction 58.1%. ERAT was associated with subsequent LRAT, and the strength of this association increased across the blanking period: month 1 (12 studies; OR 1.76, 95% CI 1.01-3.08; p = 0.05), month 2 (10 studies; OR 3.46, 95% CI 2.15-5.57; p < 0.001), and month 3 (10 studies; OR 21.4, 95% CI 10.9-42.2; p < 0.001). The graded association was reproduced within the radiofrequency and cryoballoon subgroups.

CONCLUSION: ERAT was associated with subsequent LRAT throughout the blanking period, with a graded relationship that strengthened month by month and was strongest in the third month. These findings support a blanking period shorter than the conventional 3 months.

AI.tldr: 房颤消融后空白期内早期房性心律失常复发与晚期复发相关，且关联强度逐月增强，第三个月最强（OR 21.4），提示空白期或应短于常规3个月。
AI.motivation: 房颤导管消融后前3个月内的早期复发通常归因于空白期而不视为手术失败，但越来越多证据提示早期复发可能预测晚期复发，因此传统3个月空白期可能高估了复发良性持续时间，需系统评估各月份早期复发与晚期复发的关联。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索Ovid MEDLINE、Embase和Web of Science，纳入报告空白期内特定区间早期房性心律失常复发（ERAT）并按后续晚期复发（LRAT）分层的房颤消融研究。暴露为消融后第1、2、3个月内的ERAT，结局为LRAT，采用随机效应模型合并OR及95%CI。
AI.result: 共纳入12项研究、7,751例患者（LRAT 2,505例，无LRAT 5,246例），平均随访22.0个月，平均年龄60.7岁，女性25.8%，阵发性房颤52.5%，平均CHA2DS2-VASc评分2.1，平均左房内径42.6 mm，平均LVEF 58.1%。ERAT与后续LRAT相关且关联逐月增强：第1个月OR 1.76（95%CI 1.01-3.08；p=0.05），第2个月OR 3.46（95%CI 2.15-5.57；p<0.001），第3个月OR 21.4（95%CI 10.9-42.2；p<0.001）。射频和冷冻球囊亚组中均重现该梯度关联。
AI.conclusion: 整个空白期内ERAT均与后续LRAT相关，且关联逐月增强、第三个月最强，支持将空白期缩短至短于常规3个月。该发现对消融术后随访策略和早期复发判读有影响，但研究为观察性汇总，消融能量来源亚组有限，脉冲场消融数据摘要未报告，需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）导管消融术后前3个月内复发的心房心律失常通常被归因于“空白期”，而不被归类为手术失败。越来越多的证据表明，这种早期复发的心房快速性心律失常（ERAT）反而可能预测晚期复发，这引发了担忧：传统的3个月窗口高估了复发为良性的持续时间。

目的：评估AF导管消融术后前3个月中每个月的ERAT与晚期复发的心房快速性心律失常（LRAT）之间的关联，以及这种关联是否因消融能量来源而异。

方法：我们检索了Ovid MEDLINE、Embase和Web of Science，未对日期或发表状态设限，纳入报告空白期特定时间段内ERAT、并按后续LRAT状态分层的AF导管消融研究。消融能量来源包括射频、冷冻球囊和脉冲场。暴露为消融后第1、2、3个月内的ERAT，结局为LRAT。采用随机效应模型合并比值比（OR）及其95%置信区间（CI）。

结果：共纳入12项研究，包含7,751例患者（2,505例有LRAT，5,246例无）。平均随访22.0个月，平均年龄60.7岁，25.8%为女性，52.5%为阵发性AF，平均CHA2DS2-VASc评分为2.1，平均左心房直径42.6 mm，平均左心室射血分数58.1%。ERAT与后续LRAT相关，且这种关联的强度在整个空白期内逐渐增加：第1个月（12项研究；OR 1.76，95% CI 1.01-3.08；p = 0.05），第2个月（10项研究；OR 3.46，95% CI 2.15-5.57；p < 0.001），第3个月（10项研究；OR 21.4，95% CI 10.9-42.2；p < 0.001）。这种分级关联在射频和冷冻球囊亚组中均得到重现。

结论：ERAT在整个空白期内与后续LRAT相关，呈逐月增强的分级关系，并在第3个月最强。这些发现支持空白期短于传统的3个月。

title: Timing of Catheter Ablation After Heart Failure Diagnosis for Atrial Fibrillation: A Propensity-Score-Matched Analysis
summary: Background Catheter ablation improves outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure (HF). However, most of the evidence on the importance of ablation timing has been anchored to AF rather than HF onset, leaving the optimal interval between HF diagnosis and ablation incompletely defined.Objectives To evaluate the association between the timing of catheter ablation following the first diagnosis of HF and subsequent clinical outcomes in patients with established AF.Methods We performed a retrospective propensity-score-matched cohort study using the TriNetX Research Network. Adults (≥18 years) with AF who subsequently developed HF and underwent catheter ablation were included. The primary analysis compared ablation from day 1 through 3 months after HF diagnosis with ablation at least 91 days after HF diagnosis. Propensity-score matching yielded 2,570 patients in each group. Outcomes were assessed for 2 years after ablation and included all-cause mortality, electrical cardioversion, emergency department or inpatient encounters, and HF exacerbation. A 1-year timing threshold and analyses stratified by recorded left ventricular ejection fraction were examined as sensitivity analyses.Results Mean follow-up was 549.3±253.2 days after early ablation and 534.1±255.3 days after later ablation. Mortality was similar between groups (11.0% vs 10.0%; hazard ratio [HR] 1.078, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.910-1.276; p = 0.384), as were emergency department or inpatient encounters (66.2% vs 65.6%; HR 1.006, 95% CI 0.940-1.076; p = 0.865). Early ablation was associated with fewer cardioversions (15.0% vs 18.6%; HR 0.788, 95% CI 0.689-0.901; p < 0.001) and fewer HF exacerbation events (39.5% vs 46.0%; HR 0.824, 95% CI 0.758-0.896; p < 0.001). The 1-year timing analysis showed a similar pattern for cardioversion and the HF exacerbation.Conclusions Among patients with AF and HF who ultimately underwent ablation, ablation within 3 months of HF diagnosis was associated with fewer subsequent cardioversions and HF exacerbations than ablation performed from day 91 onward. However, there was no significant difference in mortality between the two cohorts. These findings identify the first months after HF diagnosis as a clinically relevant period for reassessing rhythm-control strategy and warrant prospective evaluation of ablation timing after HF recognition.

AI.tldr: 在AF合并HF患者中，HF诊断后3个月内行导管消融较91天后消融可减少电复律和HF加重事件，但全因死亡率无差异。
AI.motivation: 导管消融可改善AF合并HF患者预后，但既往证据多基于AF病程而非HF确诊时间，HF诊断至消融的最佳间隔尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性倾向评分匹配队列研究，基于TriNetX数据库，纳入≥18岁先有AF后发生HF并接受导管消融的患者。主要比较HF诊断后1天至3个月内消融（早期组）与≥91天消融（晚期组），匹配后每组2570例。消融后随访2年，终点包括全因死亡、电复律、急诊或住院就诊、HF加重。敏感性分析采用1年时间阈值并按LVEF分层。
AI.conclusion: AF合并HF患者中，HF诊断后3个月内行导管消融与更少电复律和HF加重相关，但死亡率无差异。HF诊断后最初数月是重新评估节律控制策略的关键窗口，需前瞻性研究验证消融时机。

summary_zh: 背景：导管消融可改善心房颤动（AF）合并心力衰竭（HF）患者的预后。然而，关于消融时机重要性的证据大多基于AF而非HF发病，导致HF诊断至消融的最佳间隔尚未完全明确。目的：评估首次诊断HF后导管消融时机与既定AF患者后续临床结局之间的关联。方法：我们使用TriNetX研究网络进行了一项回顾性倾向评分匹配队列研究。纳入年龄≥18岁、患有AF、随后发生HF并接受导管消融的成人。主要分析比较HF诊断后第1天至3个月内进行的消融与HF诊断后至少91天进行的消融。倾向评分匹配后每组各2,570例患者。评估消融后2年的结局，包括全因死亡率、电复律、急诊科或住院就诊以及HF加重。敏感性分析包括1年时机阈值和按记录的左心室射血分数分层分析。结果：早期消融后平均随访549.3±253.2天，较晚消融后平均随访534.1±255.3天。两组死亡率相似（11.0% vs 10.0%；风险比[HR] 1.078，95%置信区间[CI] 0.910-1.276；p = 0.384），急诊科或住院就诊率也相似（66.2% vs 65.6%；HR 1.006，95% CI 0.940-1.076；p = 0.865）。早期消融与较少的电复律（15.0% vs 18.6%；HR 0.788，95% CI 0.689-0.901；p < 0.001）和较少的HF加重事件（39.5% vs 46.0%；HR 0.824，95% CI 0.758-0.896；p < 0.001）相关。1年时机分析显示电复律和HF加重呈现相似模式。结论：在最终接受消融的AF合并HF患者中，HF诊断后3个月内进行消融与第91天及以后进行消融相比，后续电复律和HF加重更少。然而，两个队列之间的死亡率无显著差异。这些发现表明HF诊断后的最初几个月是重新评估节律控制策略的临床相关时期，并值得对HF确诊后消融时机进行前瞻性评估。

title: Association Between Baseline Cognitive Impairment and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Catheter Ablation
summary: Background Cognitive impairment is common among patients with atrial fibrillation (AF), yet its prognostic significance in the context of catheter ablation remains unclear.Aims We aimed to investigate whether baseline cognitive impairment, assessed by the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), was associated with post-ablation AF recurrence.Methods Based on the China-AF Registry, we identified 2692 patients with nonvalvular AF who underwent index catheter ablation and had baseline MoCA assessments from 2022 to 2024. Patients were stratified into mild cognitive impairment (MCI, MoCA ≤ 26) and normal cognition (MoCA > 26) groups. The primary outcome was AF recurrence beyond the blanking period. The secondary outcome was a composite of all-cause death, ischemic stroke, and major bleeding. To adjust for confounding factors, we applied inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) methodology. Weighted Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs).Results After IPTW adjustment, all baseline covariates were well balanced (all standardized mean differences < 0.03). Over a median follow-up of 218 days (IQR, 192-376), the MCI group had a significantly higher risk of AF recurrence (aHR 1.48; 95% CI, 1.27-1.73; p < 0.001). The composite secondary endpoint did not demonstrate a statistically significant between-group difference (aHR, 1.05; 95% CI, 0.25-4.52; p = 0.945). The association between baseline MCI and AF recurrence was consistent across all prespecified subgroups (all p for interaction > 0.05).Conclusion In this large prospective registry study, an independent association was observed between baseline cognitive impairment and an elevated risk of post-ablation AF recurrence. Cognitive assessment may be useful for risk stratification but requires external validation.Clinical trial registration Clinicaltrials.gov Identifier: NCT06987825.

AI.tldr: 在2692例接受导管消融的非瓣膜性房颤患者中，基线轻度认知障碍（MoCA≤26）与消融后房颤复发风险独立相关（aHR 1.48），但复合硬终点无差异。
AI.motivation: 认知障碍在房颤患者中常见，但其对导管消融后房颤复发的预后价值尚不明确，既往缺乏大样本前瞻性队列证据。
AI.method: 基于中国房颤注册研究（China-AF Registry）的前瞻性队列，纳入2022至2024年接受首次导管消融且完成基线MoCA评估的非瓣膜性房颤患者2692例，按MoCA≤26分为轻度认知障碍（MCI）组、>26分为正常认知组。主要终点为空白期后房颤复发，次要终点为全因死亡、缺血性卒中和大出血的复合终点。采用逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）平衡混杂因素，加权Cox比例风险模型估计校正风险比（aHR）。
AI.result: 中位随访218天（IQR 192-376）。IPTW后所有基线协变量均衡（标准化均数差均<0.03）。MCI组房颤复发风险显著升高（aHR 1.48；95%CI 1.27-1.73；P<0.001）；复合次要终点组间无统计学差异（aHR 1.05；95%CI 0.25-4.52；P=0.945）。预设亚组分析中MCI与复发的关联一致（交互P均>0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 基线认知障碍与导管消融后房颤复发风险独立相关，提示认知评估或有助于风险分层，但需外部验证；复合硬终点无差异，且随访较短，认知评估对消融策略的常规指导价值尚待进一步研究。

summary_zh:
背景：认知障碍在房颤（AF）患者中较为常见，但其在导管消融背景下的预后意义仍不明确。

目的：我们旨在探讨通过蒙特利尔认知评估（MoCA）评估的基线认知障碍是否与消融后AF复发相关。

方法：基于中国房颤注册研究（China-AF Registry），我们筛选了2022年至2024年间接受首次导管消融并具有基线MoCA评估的2692例非瓣膜性AF患者。患者被分为轻度认知障碍（MCI，MoCA ≤ 26）组和认知正常（MoCA > 26）组。主要结局为空白期后的AF复发。次要结局为全因死亡、缺血性卒中和大出血的复合终点。为调整混杂因素，我们采用了逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）方法。使用加权Cox比例风险模型估计校正风险比（aHRs）。

结果：经过IPTW调整后，所有基线协变量均平衡良好（所有标准化均数差 < 0.03）。在中位随访218天（IQR，192-376）期间，MCI组AF复发风险显著更高（aHR 1.48；95% CI，1.27-1.73；p < 0.001）。复合次要终点未显示组间统计学显著差异（aHR，1.05；95% CI，0.25-4.52；p = 0.945）。基线MCI与AF复发之间的关联在所有预设亚组中一致（所有交互作用p > 0.05）。

结论：在这项大型前瞻性注册研究中，观察到基线认知障碍与消融后AF复发风险升高之间存在独立关联。认知评估可能有助于风险分层，但需要外部验证。

临床试验注册：Clinicaltrials.gov标识符：NCT06987825。

title: Unipolar electrogram-guided vs. ablation index-guided high-power short-duration pulmonary vein isolation in patients with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation: a single-center randomized controlled trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is the cornerstone of catheter ablation for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF). The ablation index (AI) provides an estimate of lesion size and depth, but does not definitively confirm transmurality. Complete elimination of the negative component of the unipolar electrogram (UPE) has been proposed as a marker of transmural lesion formation. High-power short-duration (HPSD) radiofrequency ablation (RFA) produces more homogeneous lesions with clearer boundaries and thus may be more suitable for PVI. This study aimed to assess the AI values achieved during PVI using UPE-guided HPSD RFA and to compare the efficacy and safety of UPE-guided vs. fixed AI-guided HPSD RFA in patients with PAF.

METHODS: A total of 276 patients with PAF were randomly assigned to two groups: the UPE group and the AI group. In the UPE group (n=136), the ablation endpoint for each lesion was defined as continuation of ablation for 2 seconds after conversion of the UPE morphology from RS to R. In the AI group (n=140), the ablation endpoint for each lesion was achievement of a predefined target AI value (400-450 for the anterior wall and 360-380 for the posterior wall). The pulmonary vein (PV) first-pass isolation rate, acute PV reconnection (APVR) rate, and atrial fibrillation (AF) recurrence rate were compared between groups.

RESULTS: The AI values were significantly lower in the UPE group than in the AI group (P<0.001). The inter-lesion distance (ILD) was significantly greater in the UPE group than in the AI group (P<0.001). The left and right PV first-pass isolation rates were higher in the UPE group (93.4% vs. 85.0%, P=0.03; and 95.6% vs. 89.3%, P=0.048, respectively). APVR occurred less frequently in the UPE group than in the AI group (11.0% vs. 20.0%, P=0.040). At 12 months post-procedure, AF recurrence was observed in 13 patients (9.6%) in the UPE group and 14 patients (10.0%) in the AI group (P=0.902). Three patients in the UPE group and four patients in the AI group developed inguinal hematoma (2.2% vs. 2.9%, P>0.99).

CONCLUSIONS: Both UPE-guided and AI-guided HPSD RFA were effective and safe in patients with PAF. UPE-guided ablation was associated with lower AI values, higher PV first-pass isolation rates, and a lower incidence of APVR. These findings suggest that UPE-guided HPSD RFA may provide a more individualized approach to PVI than fixed AI-guided ablation alone.

AI.tldr: 在阵发性房颤患者中，UPE引导的HPSD射频消融相比固定AI引导可提高肺静脉首次隔离率并降低急性肺静脉再连接率，但12个月房颤复发率无差异。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离是阵发性房颤导管消融的基石。消融指数（AI）可估计损伤大小和深度，但不能确切确认透壁性。单极电图（UPE）负向成分完全消除被认为是透壁损伤形成的标志。高功率短时程（HPSD）射频消融产生的损伤更均匀、边界更清晰，可能更适合PVI。本研究旨在评估UPE引导HPSD射频消融时达到的AI值，并比较UPE引导与固定AI引导HPSD射频消融在阵发性房颤患者中的疗效和安全性。
AI.method: 单中心随机对照试验，纳入276例阵发性房颤患者，随机分为UPE组（n=136）和AI组（n=140）。UPE组每个损伤的消融终点定义为UPE形态从RS转为R后继续消融2秒；AI组每个损伤的消融终点为达到预设目标AI值（前壁400-450，后壁360-380）。比较两组肺静脉首次隔离率、急性肺静脉再连接（APVR）率和房颤复发率。
AI.result: UPE组AI值显著低于AI组（P<0.001），损伤间距离（ILD）显著大于AI组（P<0.001）。UPE组左、右肺静脉首次隔离率均更高（93.4% vs. 85.0%，P=0.03；95.6% vs. 89.3%，P=0.048）。UPE组APVR发生率更低（11.0% vs. 20.0%，P=0.040）。术后12个月，UPE组13例（9.6%）和AI组14例（10.0%）出现房颤复发（P=0.902）。UPE组3例和AI组4例发生腹股沟血肿（2.2% vs. 2.9%，P>0.99）。
AI.conclusion: UPE引导和AI引导的HPSD射频消融在阵发性房颤患者中均有效且安全。UPE引导消融与更低的AI值、更高的肺静脉首次隔离率和更低的APVR发生率相关。这些发现提示UPE引导HPSD射频消融可能比单纯固定AI引导提供更个体化的PVI策略。

summary_zh:
背景：肺静脉隔离（PVI）是阵发性心房颤动（PAF）导管消融的基石。消融指数（AI）可估计损伤大小和深度，但不能明确确认透壁性。单极电图（UPE）负向成分的完全消除已被提议作为透壁损伤形成的标志。高功率短时程（HPSD）射频消融（RFA）产生更均匀、边界更清晰的损伤，因此可能更适合PVI。本研究旨在评估使用UPE引导的HPSD RFA进行PVI期间达到的AI值，并比较UPE引导与固定AI引导的HPSD RFA在PAF患者中的疗效和安全性。

方法：共276例PAF患者被随机分配到两组：UPE组和AI组。在UPE组（n=136）中，每个损伤的消融终点定义为UPE形态从RS转为R后继续消融2秒。在AI组（n=140）中，每个损伤的消融终点为达到预定的目标AI值（前壁400-450，后壁360-380）。比较两组间的肺静脉（PV）首次隔离率、急性PV重连（APVR）率和心房颤动（AF）复发率。

结果：UPE组的AI值显著低于AI组（P<0.001）。UPE组的损伤间距离（ILD）显著大于AI组（P<0.001）。UPE组的左、右PV首次隔离率更高（分别为93.4% vs. 85.0%，P=0.03；95.6% vs. 89.3%，P=0.048）。UPE组APVR发生率低于AI组（11.0% vs. 20.0%，P=0.040）。术后12个月，UPE组有13例（9.6%）患者观察到AF复发，AI组有14例（10.0%）患者（P=0.902）。UPE组有3例患者、AI组有4例患者出现腹股沟血肿（2.2% vs. 2.9%，P>0.99）。

结论：UPE引导和AI引导的HPSD RFA在PAF患者中均有效且安全。UPE引导的消融与较低的AI值、较高的PV首次隔离率和较低的APVR发生率相关。这些发现表明，UPE引导的HPSD RFA可能比仅固定AI引导的消融提供更个体化的PVI方法。

title: Clinical and nosological determinants of zonulin and trimethylamine N-oxide levels in patientswith atrial fibrillation
summary: Aim. To compare fecal zonulin and plasma trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) profiles in healthy volunteers and patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Material and methods. The comparative study involved 163 participants, divided into two following groups: 48 healthy individuals and 113 patients with AF. The groups were comparable by age characteristics (KS p>0,05; 37 to 60 years, Me =46, 41,8-53,3; 40 to 59 years, Me =49, 43-53, respectively). There was the following sex distribution among groups (Chi-squared p<0,05): 81% women and 19% men in the healthy study group and 49,6% and 50,4% in the AF group, respectively. Results. Patients with AF were associated with higher plasma TMAO levels (KS p<0,05) compared to healthy controls (Me =5,2, 4,4-6,4 μmol/L and Me =2,7, 2,4-3,2 μmol/L, respectively). Zonulin distribution was similar between the two groups (KS p<0,05; Me =111,5, 101,8-124 ng/ml and Me =50,4, 46,6-67,6 ng/ml, respectively). AF was associated with a 1,1 μmol/L increase in TMAO, with the greatest contribution from long-term persistent AF (+1,79 μmol/L). TMAO levels were further increased by EHRA III (+1,78 μmol/L), hypertension (+0,86 μmol/L), and heart failure (+0,80 μmol/L). For zonulin, AF led to a 35,9 ng/mL increase, with a gradient increase from paroxysmal AF (+6,4 ng/mL) to long-standing persistent AF (+22,8 ng/mL). Severe AF symptoms (EHRA III: +30,2 ng/mL) and hypertension (+7,7 ng/mL) contributed significantly, while the heart failure effect was minimal (+1,2 ng/mL). Conclusion. Fecal zonulin and plasma TMAO in patients with AF can be used as markers of low-grade inflammation associated with intestinal wall condition.

AI.tldr: 房颤患者血浆TMAO和粪便连蛋白水平显著高于健康对照，且与房颤类型、EHRA分级及高血压、心衰相关。
AI.motivation: 房颤与肠道菌群代谢产物及肠道屏障功能的关系尚不明确，既往缺乏对连蛋白和TMAO在房颤患者中临床及疾病类型决定因素的系统比较。
AI.method: 比较性研究纳入163名参与者，分为健康对照组48人和房颤组113人。两组年龄可比（P>0.05），性别分布差异有统计学意义（P<0.05）。检测粪便连蛋白和血浆TMAO水平，分析房颤及临床因素（房颤类型、EHRA分级、高血压、心衰）对标志物水平的影响。统计方法包括KS检验和卡方检验，效应量以均值差表示。
AI.result: 房颤组血浆TMAO中位数5.2 μmol/L（4.4-6.4）显著高于健康组2.7 μmol/L（2.4-3.2）（P<0.05）。连蛋白两组分布相似（房颤组111.5 ng/ml vs 健康组50.4 ng/ml，P<0.05）。房颤使TMAO增加1.1 μmol/L，长程持续性房颤贡献最大（+1.79 μmol/L），EHRA III级（+1.78 μmol/L）、高血压（+0.86 μmol/L）和心衰（+0.80 μmol/L）进一步升高TMAO。房颤使连蛋白增加35.9 ng/mL，从阵发性房颤（+6.4 ng/mL）到长程持续性房颤（+22.8 ng/mL）呈梯度增加；EHRA III级（+30.2 ng/mL）和高血压（+7.7 ng/mL）贡献显著，心衰影响较小（+1.2 ng/mL）。
AI.conclusion: 房颤患者粪便连蛋白和血浆TMAO可作为与肠道壁状态相关的低度炎症标志物，其水平受房颤类型、症状严重程度及合并症影响。这提示肠道屏障功能与房颤的炎症机制相关，但研究为横断面设计，无法确定因果关系，且样本量有限，需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 目的。比较健康志愿者和心房颤动（AF）患者的粪便连蛋白和血浆氧化三甲胺（TMAO）谱。材料与方法。这项比较研究纳入了163名参与者，分为以下两组：48名健康个体和113名AF患者。两组在年龄特征上具有可比性（KS p>0.05；分别为37至60岁，Me=46，41.8-53.3；40至59岁，Me=49，43-53）。组间性别分布如下（卡方 p<0.05）：健康研究组中女性占81%，男性占19%，AF组中分别为49.6%和50.4%。结果。与健康对照组相比，AF患者与更高的血浆TMAO水平相关（KS p<0.05）（分别为Me=5.2，4.4-6.4 μmol/L和Me=2.7，2.4-3.2 μmol/L）。两组间连蛋白分布相似（KS p<0.05；分别为Me=111.5，101.8-124 ng/ml和Me=50.4，46.6-67.6 ng/ml）。AF与TMAO增加1.1 μmol/L相关，其中长期持续性AF贡献最大（+1.79 μmol/L）。EHRA III（+1.78 μmol/L）、高血压（+0.86 μmol/L）和心力衰竭（+0.80 μmol/L）进一步增加了TMAO水平。对于连蛋白，AF导致增加35.9 ng/mL，从阵发性AF（+6.4 ng/mL）到长程持续性AF（+22.8 ng/mL）呈梯度增加。严重AF症状（EHRA III：+30.2 ng/mL）和高血压（+7.7 ng/mL）贡献显著，而心力衰竭影响最小（+1.2 ng/mL）。结论。AF患者的粪便连蛋白和血浆TMAO可作为与肠壁状况相关的低度炎症标志物。

title: Use Of a Selective Cardiac Myosin Atpase Inhibitor in a Patient with Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy with Critical Left Ventricular Outflow Tract Obstruction and Pulmonary Hypertension
summary: Introduction. A clinical case of the use of a cardiac myosin ATPase inhibitor in a female patient with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) characterized by critical obstruction and pulmonary hypertension (PH) is presented. Case summary . A 50-year-old female patient with obstructive HCM (pathogenic nucleotide variant p.R1420Q in the MYH7 gene) was hospitalized with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (heart rate up to 170 bpm) and pulmonary edema. Sinus rhythm was restored by electrical cardioversion. The peak left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) obstruction gradient was 112 mmHg, and systolic pulmonary artery pressure (sPAP) was 114 mmHg. Surgical treatment was declined due to severe pulmonary hypertension. The patient began treatment with the cardiac myosin ATPase inhibitor mavacamten at a dose of 2.5 mg, with follow-up assessments after 3.5 weeks and after 3 months of the therapy starting. As a result of treatment sPAP decreased to 71 mmHg and the peak LVOT pressure gradient (Pg max) dropped to 73 mmHg; consequently, the patient successfully underwent an extended septal myectomy. Treatment with mavacamten was discontinued. Conclusion : Treatment with the cardiac myosin ATPase inhibitor mavacamten (2.5 mg) for 3.5 months in a patient with severe obstructive HCM and significant pulmonary hypertension resulted in a reduction of systolic pulmonary artery pressure, enabling successful surgery.
journal: The Russian Archives of Internal Medicine

AI.tldr: 一例50岁女性梗阻性HCM合并重度肺动脉高压患者，经mavacamten治疗3.5个月后sPAP从114降至71 mmHg、LVOT压差从112降至73 mmHg，成功接受室间隔心肌切除术。
AI.motivation: 梗阻性肥厚型心肌病（HCM）合并重度肺动脉高压（PH）时外科手术风险极高，常被拒绝手术；心脏肌球蛋白ATP酶抑制剂mavacamten在此类高危人群中的疗效与安全性证据有限，摘要未报告既往相关研究数据。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为50岁女性梗阻性HCM患者（MYH7基因p.R1420Q致病性变异），因阵发性房颤（心室率最快170 bpm）及肺水肿入院，电复律恢复窦性心律；基线峰值左心室流出道（LVOT）压差112 mmHg，收缩期肺动脉压（sPAP）114 mmHg，因重度PH拒绝外科手术。给予mavacamten 2.5 mg治疗，分别于3.5周和3个月时随访评估sPAP与LVOT压差，后续行扩大室间隔心肌切除术并停用mavacamten。摘要未报告统计方法。
AI.result: 治疗3.5个月后，sPAP由114 mmHg降至71 mmHg，峰值LVOT压差由112 mmHg降至73 mmHg；患者随后成功接受扩大室间隔心肌切除术，并停用mavacamten。摘要未报告随访时间点具体数值、不良反应及统计检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 对于合并重度肺动脉高压、外科手术高危的梗阻性HCM患者，mavacamten短期治疗可降低sPAP和LVOT压差，为后续室间隔心肌切除术创造条件。该结果为单例观察，样本量极小、缺乏对照，尚不能推广至一般人群，需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh: 引言。本文介绍了一例使用心脏肌球蛋白ATP酶抑制剂治疗女性肥厚型心肌病（HCM）患者的临床病例，该患者以严重梗阻和肺动脉高压（PH）为特征。病例摘要。一名50岁女性梗阻性HCM患者（MYH7基因致病性核苷酸变异p.R1420Q）因阵发性心房颤动（心率高达170次/分）和肺水肿住院。通过电复律恢复窦性心律。左心室流出道（LVOT）峰值梗阻压差为112 mmHg，收缩期肺动脉压（sPAP）为114 mmHg。由于严重肺动脉高压，患者拒绝手术治疗。患者开始接受心脏肌球蛋白ATP酶抑制剂mavacamten治疗，剂量为2.5 mg，并在治疗开始后3.5周和3个月时进行随访评估。治疗结果使sPAP降至71 mmHg，LVOT峰值压差（Pg max）降至73 mmHg；因此，患者成功接受了扩大室间隔心肌切除术。mavacamten治疗停止。结论：对一名患有严重梗阻性HCM和显著肺动脉高压的患者，使用心脏肌球蛋白ATP酶抑制剂mavacamten（2.5 mg）治疗3.5个月，导致收缩期肺动脉压降低，使手术得以成功进行。

title: Life-Threatening Ventricular Tachycardia and Transient Brugada-Like Electrocardiographic Abnormalities Caused by Severe Hyperkalemia Due to Urinary Retention in a 55-Year-Old Man
summary: BACKGROUND Hyperkalemia is a potentially fatal electrolyte disturbance that typically manifests as progressive conduction abnormalities, bradyarrhythmias, and sine-wave electrocardiographic changes. In rare cases, however, severe hyperkalemia also presents with malignant ventricular tachyarrhythmias and transient electrocardiographic abnormalities involving the right precordial leads, potentially leading to diagnostic confusion with primary arrhythmic disorders. CASE REPORT A 55-year-old man with no known cardiovascular disease presented with palpitations, dyspnea, and diaphoresis. Electrocardiography demonstrated sustained wide-QRS ventricular tachycardia accompanied by hemodynamic instability. Following electrical cardioversion, recurrent ventricular tachyarrhythmias occurred, requiring repeated defibrillation, cardiopulmonary resuscitation, intravenous amiodarone, and mechanical ventilation. Laboratory testing revealed severe hyperkalemia (7.6 mmol/L), profound metabolic acidosis (pH 7.059, HCO₃⁻ 13.8 mmol/L), and advanced renal dysfunction. Serum potassium was confirmed on repeat testing. Subsequent electrocardiography demonstrated marked QRS widening, terminal conduction delay, and transient right precordial ST-segment abnormalities involving leads V1-V2. Intravenous calcium gluconate and sodium bicarbonate rapidly improved the electrocardiographic abnormalities. Continuous hemodiafiltration and bladder catheterization were performed after postrenal acute kidney injury caused by urinary retention was identified. Correction of hyperkalemia together with treatment of metabolic acidosis resulted in complete resolution of the ventricular arrhythmias and electrocardiographic abnormalities without recurrence. No evidence of structural heart disease or persistent myocardial ischemia was identified during subsequent evaluation. CONCLUSIONS This case illustrates that severe hyperkalemia secondary to reversible postrenal acute kidney injury can simultaneously present with malignant ventricular tachyarrhythmia and transient electrocardiographic abnormalities. Recognition of this reversible metabolic condition is essential to avoid diagnostic error and facilitate prompt life-saving treatment.

AI.tldr: 55岁男性因尿潴留致严重高钾血症，表现为持续性室速和Brugada样心电图改变，纠正高钾后心律失常完全消失。
AI.motivation: 高钾血症通常表现为传导阻滞和缓慢性心律失常，但罕见情况下可导致恶性室性心动过速和右胸导联一过性Brugada样心电图改变，易误诊为原发性心律失常疾病，需提高认识以避免误诊。
AI.method: 病例报告。研究对象为一名55岁无已知心血管疾病的男性，因心悸、呼吸困难、出汗就诊。干预措施包括电复律、反复除颤、心肺复苏、静脉胺碘酮、机械通气、静脉葡萄糖酸钙和碳酸氢钠、连续血液透析滤过及导尿。主要观察心电图和实验室指标变化及心律失常转归。
AI.result: 心电图示持续性宽QRS波室性心动过速伴血流动力学不稳定，电复律后复发室性心动过速需反复除颤。实验室检查示严重高钾血症（7.6 mmol/L）、代谢性酸中毒（pH 7.059，HCO₃⁻ 13.8 mmol/L）和晚期肾功能不全。后续心电图示QRS波显著增宽、终末传导延迟及V1-V2导联一过性ST段异常。静脉葡萄糖酸钙和碳酸氢钠快速改善心电图异常。纠正高钾和酸中毒后室性心律失常和心电图异常完全消失，无复发。
AI.conclusion: 严重高钾血症继发于可逆性肾后性急性肾损伤可同时表现为恶性室性心动过速和一过性心电图异常，识别这一可逆代谢病因对避免误诊和及时挽救生命至关重要。

summary_zh: 背景：高钾血症是一种可能致命的电解质紊乱，通常表现为进行性传导异常、缓慢性心律失常和正弦波心电图改变。然而，在罕见情况下，严重高钾血症也可表现为恶性室性快速性心律失常和累及右胸导联的短暂性心电图异常，可能导致与原发性心律失常疾病的诊断混淆。病例报告：一名无已知心血管疾病的55岁男性因心悸、呼吸困难和出汗就诊。心电图显示持续性宽QRS波群室性心动过速，伴有血流动力学不稳定。电复律后，复发性室性快速性心律失常发生，需要反复除颤、心肺复苏、静脉注射胺碘酮和机械通气。实验室检查显示严重高钾血症（7.6 mmol/L）、严重代谢性酸中毒（pH 7.059，HCO₃⁻ 13.8 mmol/L）和晚期肾功能不全。重复检测确认了血清钾水平。随后的心电图显示显著的QRS波增宽、终末传导延迟以及累及V1-V2导联的短暂性右胸导联ST段异常。静脉注射葡萄糖酸钙和碳酸氢钠迅速改善了心电图异常。在确定尿潴留导致的肾后性急性肾损伤后，进行了连续性血液透析滤过和膀胱导尿。纠正高钾血症及治疗代谢性酸中毒后，室性心律失常和心电图异常完全消退，无复发。后续评估未发现结构性心脏病或持续性心肌缺血的证据。结论：本病例表明，继发于可逆性肾后性急性肾损伤的严重高钾血症可同时表现为恶性室性快速性心律失常和短暂性心电图异常。识别这一可逆性代谢状况对于避免诊断错误和促进及时挽救生命的治疗至关重要。

title: Anesthetic Challenges in Interarterial Right Coronary Artery Anomaly from the Left Sinus of Valsalva: A Case Report.
summary: Coronary artery anomalies are rare but clinically significant malformations, particularly when involving an interarterial course, which predisposes to ischemia and sudden cardiac death. We report the case of a previously healthy 22-year-old man who suffered out-of-hospital cardiac arrest associated with recreational inhalant use. Imaging revealed an anomalous right coronary artery originating from the left sinus of Valsalva with interarterial trajectory. Surgical reimplantation was performed under tailored anesthetic management emphasizing hemodynamic stability. The patient recovered uneventfully. This case discusses and highlights anesthetic priorities and the potential role of external triggers in vulnerable coronary anatomy.

AI.tldr: 一例22岁健康男性因娱乐性吸入剂使用发生院外心脏骤停，影像发现右冠状动脉起自左冠状窦并呈动脉间走行，在个体化麻醉管理下完成手术再植并顺利康复。

title: Clinical practice guidelines: management of non-post-operative supra-ventricular tachycardia in neonates and children less than 18 years old hospitalized in a Pediatric Intensive Care Unit.
authors: French Speaking Group for Pediatric Intensive and Emergency Care
summary:
PURPOSE: We present guidelines in the form of pragmatic recommendations for management of neonates and children less than 18 years old presenting with non-post-operative supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) and hospitalized in a Paediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU).

METHODS: Thirteen French-speaking experts, all of them members of the Groupe Francophone de Réanimation et Urgence Pédiatriques (French-speaking group of paediatric intensive and emergency care; GFRUP), collaborated from 2024 to 2025 through teleconferences and face-to-face meetings. The guidelines cover four areas: (1) epidemiology and criteria for admission to a PICU, (2) paraclinical assessment, (3) non-specific rhythm management, and (4) specific rhythm management. The questions were formulated in the Patient-Intervention-Comparison-Outcome (PICO) format. An extensive Anglophone and Francophone literature search indexed in the MEDLINE database via PubMed, Cochrane and Embase was performed using pre-established keywords. The texts were analyzed and classified according to the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) methodology. When this method was not applicable, an expert opinion was given. Each of the recommendations was voted on by all the experts according to the Delphi methodology.

RESULTS: The group proposes 21 recommendations. The GRADE methodology could be applied for five of them, and an expert opinion was given for the remaining 16. All of the recommendations received strong approval.

CONCLUSION: These guidelines cover different aspects in the management of non-post-operative SVT in children hospitalized in PICUs including non-specific and specific rhythm management.

AI.tldr: 法国专家组发布21条儿童非术后室上性心动过速管理指南，仅5条基于GRADE证据，16条为专家意见，均获强力推荐。
AI.motivation: 儿童非术后室上性心动过速（SVT）在PICU中的管理缺乏统一规范，既往证据有限，需制定基于现有证据和专家共识的实践推荐以指导临床。
AI.method: 由13名法语区儿科重症与急诊专家（GFRUP成员）于2024-2025年通过远程和面对面会议制定指南，覆盖流行病学与PICU收治标准、辅助检查、非特异性心律管理和特异性心律管理四个领域。问题采用PICO格式，检索MEDLINE（PubMed）、Cochrane和Embase数据库，文献按GRADE方法分级，不适用时给出专家意见，所有推荐经Delphi法投票。
AI.result: 共提出21条推荐，其中5条可应用GRADE方法，16条基于专家意见；所有推荐均获得强力批准。摘要未报告具体推荐内容及投票数据。
AI.conclusion: 该指南为PICU住院儿童非术后SVT的管理提供了涵盖非特异性和特异性心律管理的实践推荐，但多数推荐基于专家意见而非高质量证据，临床应用中需结合具体情况，未来需更多研究提供高级别证据。

summary_zh:
目的：我们以实用建议的形式提出指南，用于管理因非术后室上性心动过速（SVT）入住儿科重症监护病房（PICU）的新生儿和18岁以下儿童。

方法：十三位法语专家，均为法语儿科重症与急诊学组（Groupe Francophone de Réanimation et Urgence Pédiatriques，GFRUP）成员，于2024年至2025年间通过电话会议和面对面会议合作。该指南涵盖四个领域：（1）流行病学及入住PICU的标准，（2）辅助检查评估，（3）非特异性心律管理，（4）特异性心律管理。问题以患者-干预-比较-结局（PICO）格式提出。使用预先设定的关键词，对MEDLINE数据库（通过PubMed）、Cochrane和Embase中索引的广泛英语和法语文献进行了检索。文本根据推荐分级的评估、制定与评价（GRADE）方法进行分析和分级。当该方法不适用时，给出专家意见。每条推荐均由所有专家根据德尔菲法进行投票。

结果：该小组提出了21条推荐。其中5条可应用GRADE方法，其余16条给出了专家意见。所有推荐均获得强烈赞同。

结论：这些指南涵盖了入住PICU儿童非术后SVT管理的不同方面，包括非特异性和特异性心律管理。

title: Understanding the Mortality Trends in Patients With Ventricular Arrhythmias and Cardiomyopathy: A 25‐Year Retrospective Analysis From 1999–2024
summary: BACKGROUND: Ventricular Arrhythmias (VA) associated with Cardiomyopathy (CM) continues to be the major cause of death. However, a national longitudinal study examining mortality trends from these conditions is still lacking. This study assessed mortality trends due to these conditions among U.S. adults aged ≥ 25 years from 1999 to 2024. METHODS: An observational analysis of U.S. mortalities due to VA in patients with CM (ICD-10 I47.2, I49.0 and I25.5, I42 respectively), was conducted using CDC WONDER. Adjusted Mortality Rates (AAMR) per 100,000 calculated and trends were assessed by calculating Average and Annual Percent Change (AAPC, APC), using joinpoint regression stratified by year, sex, race, and region. RESULTS: From 1999 to 2024, 81,204 VA with CM-related deaths occurred with the overall AAMR declined from 2.54 in 1999 to 1.01 in 2024 (AAPC: -3.55%; p < 0.000001). AAMRs decreased from 1999 to 2007 (APC: -7.93), remained stable till 2022 (APC: -0.66), and dropped by 2024 (APC: -6.87). Men exhibited greater AAMRs (2.42) than women (0.68). Racially, the AAMRs were most pronounced in Non-Hispanic (NH) Blacks (1.97), followed by NH Whites (1.42), whereas Hispanics and NH Others experienced similar AAMRs of 0.97. Geographically, Delaware and the Western regions experienced the highest rates of mortality (2.2 and 1.53, respectively). Urban areas had higher AAMRs than rural settings (1.45 vs. 1.4) CONCLUSION: Although VA-CM mortality has declined over the past two decades, differences by race, sex, and geography remain, underscoring the need for targeted healthcare strategies.

AI.tldr: 1999至2024年美国≥25岁室性心律失常合并心肌病患者死亡例数达81204例，年龄调整死亡率从2.54降至1.01/10万（AAPC -3.55%，P<0.000001），但性别、种族和地域差异持续存在。
AI.motivation: 室性心律失常（VA）合并心肌病（CM）是主要死因，但缺乏全国性纵向死亡率趋势研究，本研究旨在填补这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 基于CDC WONDER数据库的观察性分析，纳入1999-2024年美国≥25岁VA合并CM死亡病例（ICD-10编码I47.2、I49.0、I25.5、I42），计算每10万人年龄调整死亡率（AAMR），采用joinpoint回归按年份、性别、种族和地区分层计算平均年度百分比变化（AAPC）和年度百分比变化（APC）。
AI.result: 共81204例死亡，总体AAMR从1999年2.54降至2024年1.01（AAPC -3.55%，P<0.000001）。1999-2007年APC -7.93，2007-2022年稳定（APC -0.66），2022-2024年再降（APC -6.87）。男性AAMR（2.42）高于女性（0.68）；非西班牙裔黑人最高（1.97），其次非西班牙裔白人（1.42），西班牙裔和非西班牙裔其他人群均为0.97；特拉华州（2.2）和西部地区（1.53）死亡率最高；城市略高于农村（1.45 vs 1.4）。
AI.conclusion: 过去二十五年VA-CM死亡率总体下降，但性别、种族和地理差异持续存在，提示需针对性医疗策略；本研究为观察性设计，无法推断因果关系，且缺乏临床细节和器械治疗信息。

summary_zh:
背景：与心肌病（CM）相关的室性心律失常（VA）仍然是主要死亡原因。然而，尚缺乏关于这些疾病死亡率趋势的全国性纵向研究。本研究评估了1999年至2024年美国≥25岁成年人中这些疾病导致的死亡率趋势。

方法：使用CDC WONDER对CM患者中VA（ICD-10分别为I47.2、I49.0和I25.5、I42）导致的美国死亡率进行观察性分析。计算每10万人的调整死亡率（AAMR），并通过计算平均年度百分比变化（AAPC）和年度百分比变化（APC）评估趋势，使用按年份、性别、种族和地区分层的joinpoint回归。

结果：从1999年到2024年，共发生81,204例VA伴CM相关死亡，总体AAMR从1999年的2.54下降到2024年的1.01（AAPC：-3.55%；p < 0.000001）。AAMR从1999年到2007年下降（APC：-7.93），至2022年保持稳定（APC：-0.66），到2024年下降（APC：-6.87）。男性的AAMR（2.42）高于女性（0.68）。在种族方面，AAMR在非西班牙裔（NH）黑人中最为显著（1.97），其次是NH白人（1.42），而西班牙裔和NH其他人群的AAMR相似，为0.97。在地理上，特拉华州和西部地区死亡率最高（分别为2.2和1.53）。城市地区的AAMR高于农村地区（1.45 vs. 1.4）。

结论：尽管VA-CM死亡率在过去二十年中有所下降，但种族、性别和地理差异仍然存在，强调需要有针对性的医疗保健策略。

title: Pituitary Histopathology in Fatal Heroin Intoxication, Suicidal Hanging, and Sudden Cardiac Death: An Exploratory Retrospective Autopsy Study
summary: Background/Objectives: The pituitary gland is highly susceptible to hypoxic–ischemic injury because of its distinctive vascular architecture, yet its forensic significance in non-traumatic deaths remains poorly defined. This study aimed to compare pituitary histopathology across deaths caused by different mechanisms of systemic hypoxia. Methods: This retrospective observational study investigated pituitary histopathology in 30 forensic autopsies performed between 2019 and 2025, including suicidal hanging (n = 10), fatal heroin intoxication with respiratory failure (n = 10), and sudden cardiac death controls (n = 10). Hematoxylin–eosin-stained sections were systematically evaluated for hemorrhagic, ischemic, and necrotic changes and their anatomical distribution. Results: Neurohypophyseal hemorrhage was detected in 6/10 hanging cases and 8/10 heroin-related deaths, but in no controls. Adenohypophyseal ischemic–necrotic lesions occurred in 2/10 hanging cases and 6/10 heroin cases and were absent in controls. Lesions were generally more extensive in heroin intoxication, where hemorrhage often coexisted with vascular congestion and coagulative necrosis. The preferential involvement of the posterior lobe by hemorrhage and the anterior lobe by ischemic–necrotic injury is consistent with their different vascular supplies. Conclusions: These exploratory findings require validation. Hypoxia duration and residual perfusion were not measured. Pituitary sampling may be a complementary tool worth investigating in selected forensic cases; its routine utility was not assessed. Because all sections were stained with hematoxylin–eosin only, these findings are preliminary and require confirmation.

AI.tldr: 探索性尸检研究显示，垂体后叶出血见于缢死与海洛因致死但心脏性猝死对照无，海洛因组缺血坏死更重，样本小仅HE染色待验证。
AI.motivation: 垂体因独特血管构型易受缺氧-缺血损伤，但其在非创伤性死亡中的法医学意义尚不明确；既往缺乏对不同系统性缺氧机制（缢死、海洛因中毒呼吸衰竭、心脏性猝死）之间垂体组织病理差异的系统比较。
AI.method: 回顾性观察性尸检研究，纳入2019—2025年30例法医尸检，分为自杀缢死组（n=10）、海洛因中毒致呼吸衰竭组（n=10）与心脏性猝死对照组（n=10）；HE染色切片系统评估出血、缺血及坏死性改变及其解剖分布；摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 神经垂体出血在缢死组6/10、海洛因组8/10检出，对照组0/10；腺垂体缺血-坏死性病变在缢死组2/10、海洛因组6/10，对照组未见。海洛因中毒组病变范围更广，出血常与血管充血及凝固性坏死并存；出血好发于后叶、缺血坏死好发于前叶，与两者血供差异相符。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI及P值。

title: Incremental prognostic value of hepatic tissue alterations derived from cardiac magnetic resonance imaging for arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy: a case-control study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Hepatic injury occurs in patients with cardiovascular disease and is associated with adverse clinical outcomes. The prognostic value of hepatic tissue alterations in patients with arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy (ARVC) remains unclear. We aimed to evaluate the incremental prognostic value of hepatic native T1 in predicting sustained ventricular arrhythmia (VA) in patients with ARVC.

METHODS: This retrospective study included patients with definite ARVC who underwent cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) examinations between August 2014 and October 2024. Hepatic native T1 values were derived from standard cardiac T1 maps. The clinical outcome was the first occurrence of sustained VA. Cox regression analysis was used to determine the association of variables with sustained VA. Incremental prognostic value was evaluated according to the concordance statistic (C-statistic), likelihood ratio test, and the continuous net reclassification index.

RESULTS: A total of 94 patients with definite ARVC (mean age 37.3±14.2 years; 67% male) were included. At a median follow-up of 39 months, sustained VA occurred in 34 (36%) patients. In multivariable Cox analysis, hepatic native T1 was an independent predictor of sustained VA [hazard ratio (HR) =1.02, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.00-1.03; P=0.025]. A model combining hepatic native T1 with the ARVC risk score and CMR-derived right ventricular global longitudinal strain (RV GLS) showed improved discrimination and calibration for sustained VA (C-statistic =0.760; likelihood ratio =20.14) compared with models composed of ARVC risk score alone (C-statistic =0.680; likelihood ratio =9.20; P<0.001) or the ARVC risk score and RV GLS (C-statistic =0.735; likelihood ratio =15.30; P=0.028).

CONCLUSIONS: Hepatic native T1 derived from cardiac T1 maps was an independent predictor of sustained VA in patients with ARVC, providing incremental prognostic value when incorporated into a model with ARVC risk score and RV GLS.

AI.tldr: 在94例确诊ARVC患者中，基于心脏磁共振T1 mapping获得的肝脏native T1是持续性室性心律失常的独立预测因子，将其加入ARVC风险评分和右室整体纵向应变模型可提升预测效能。
AI.motivation: 心血管疾病患者常合并肝脏损伤且与不良预后相关，但肝脏组织改变（如native T1）在致心律失常性右室心肌病（ARVC）患者中的预后价值尚不明确。本研究旨在评估肝脏native T1对ARVC患者持续性室性心律失常（VA）的增量预后价值。
AI.method: 回顾性病例对照研究，纳入2014年8月至2024年10月接受心脏磁共振（CMR）检查的确诊ARVC患者94例。从标准心脏T1 mapping图像中提取肝脏native T1值。临床终点为首次发生持续性VA。采用Cox回归分析变量与持续性VA的关联，通过C统计量、似然比检验和连续净重分类指数评估增量预后价值。
AI.result: 中位随访39个月，34例（36%）发生持续性VA。多变量Cox分析显示，肝脏native T1是持续性VA的独立预测因子（HR=1.02，95%CI：1.00-1.03；P=0.025）。将肝脏native T1加入ARVC风险评分和CMR-derived右室整体纵向应变（RV GLS）的联合模型，较ARVC风险评分单独模型（C统计量0.760 vs 0.680；似然比20.14 vs 9.20；P<0.001）及ARVC风险评分联合RV GLS模型（C统计量0.760 vs 0.735；似然比20.14 vs 15.30；P=0.028）均显著改善判别和校准。
AI.conclusion: 基于心脏T1 mapping获得的肝脏native T1是ARVC患者持续性VA的独立预测因子，将其纳入ARVC风险评分和RV GLS模型可提供增量预后价值，有助于优化ARVC患者的风险分层。本研究为回顾性单中心设计，样本量有限，结论需前瞻性多中心研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心血管疾病患者可发生肝损伤，并与不良临床结局相关。致心律失常性右心室心肌病（ARVC）患者肝组织改变的预后价值尚不明确。我们旨在评估肝脏原生T1预测ARVC患者持续性室性心律失常（VA）的增量预后价值。

方法：这项回顾性研究纳入2014年8月至2024年10月期间接受心脏磁共振（CMR）检查的明确ARVC患者。肝脏原生T1值来源于标准心脏T1 mapping。临床结局为首次发生持续性VA。采用Cox回归分析确定变量与持续性VA的相关性。根据一致性统计量（C-statistic）、似然比检验和连续净重分类指数评估增量预后价值。

结果：共纳入94例明确ARVC患者（平均年龄37.3±14.2岁；67%为男性）。中位随访39个月时，34例（36%）患者发生持续性VA。在多变量Cox分析中，肝脏原生T1是持续性VA的独立预测因子[风险比（HR）=1.02，95%置信区间（CI）：1.00-1.03；P=0.025]。与仅由ARVC风险评分组成的模型（C-statistic=0.680；似然比=9.20；P<0.001）或ARVC风险评分联合右心室整体纵向应变（RV GLS）的模型（C-statistic=0.735；似然比=15.30；P=0.028）相比，将肝脏原生T1与ARVC风险评分及CMR衍生的RV GLS联合的模型对持续性VA的区分度和校准度均有所改善（C-statistic=0.760；似然比=20.14）。

结论：来源于心脏T1 mapping的肝脏原生T1是ARVC患者持续性VA的独立预测因子，将其纳入ARVC风险评分和RV GLS的模型时可提供增量预后价值。

title: Corrigendum to “Twenty years in the battle against sudden cardiac death: progress, pitfalls, and prospects for the future” [Resusc. Plus 31 (2026) 101401]

summary: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is a myocardial disease characterized by left ventricular hypertrophy without abnormal loading conditions. Despite significant advances in management, HCM remains a major cause of sudden cardiac death, particularly in young individuals. Prevention relies on accurate arrhythmic risk stratification and the selective implantation of implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs). This article reviews current indications for primary prevention ICD implantation in sarcomeric HCM based on the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) guidelines and compares them with the more integrative approach proposed by the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association (ACC/AHA).

title: Clinical Case of a Patient with Stable Ventricular Tachycardia and Primary Hyperaldosteronism
summary: This article describes a clinical case of the detection of primary hyperaldosteronism (PA) a 37-years-old female patient has. The patient was urgently hospitalized at the Cardiology department because of stable polymorphic ventricular tachycardis (V-tach) episode. The feature of the disease in her case is a sudden manifestation of PA in the form of ventricular arrhythmias compared with the long period of essential hypertension (EH) without symptomatic origin signs. The detailing of diagnostic steps confirms the importance of potassium level determining for patients with arrhythmia when they are taken to hospitals. Electrolyte analysis is an important aspect of the diagnostic search with a persistent elevated blood pressure and without traditional risk factors EH. In the present case the persistent hypokalemia without anamnestic preconditions for likelihood of electrolyte disturbances has been detected. Primary hyperaldosteronism has a wide range of clinical manifestations described in the medical literature. Present observation confirms the possibility of an atypical clinical course of PA, and it shows objective suitability of searching of adrenal tumors as a reason for letal arrhythmias occurrence. Ventricular rhythm disturbances in the PA are probable option of electrical instability of the myocardium that occurs against the background of grave electrolyte disorders. In this observation medication-assisted treatment with amiodaron, aldosteron antagonists stabilizided the patient`s condition during the preoperative period. This clinical case demonstrates continuity between physicians of various specialties (cardiologist, endocrinologist, surgeon-urologist) during diagnosis and treatment with aldosteronism, as well it considers the peculiarities of cardiologic support for patients with rhythm disturbances, in need surgery of adrenal tumors.

AI.motivation: 原发性醛固酮增多症（PA）临床表现多样，但以室性心律失常为首发表现者罕见。对于无传统高血压危险因素、持续血压升高伴心律失常的患者，易忽略继发性高血压病因，导致诊断延迟。本文旨在通过一例以室速为首发表现的PA病例，强调电解质分析在心律失常病因排查中的价值。
AI.method: 单病例报告。对象为37岁女性，因稳定型多形性室速急诊入院，既往有长期原发性高血压史但无典型PA症状。干预/暴露：诊断性评估包括电解质检测、醛固酮相关检查及影像学寻找肾上腺肿瘤。终点为明确PA诊断及术前药物稳定病情。统计方法：描述性分析，无组间比较。
AI.result: 患者表现为稳定型多形性室速，伴持续低钾血症且无既往电解质紊乱诱因。经系统检查确诊PA，并发现肾上腺肿瘤。术前使用胺碘酮和醛固酮拮抗剂稳定病情，未再发室速。摘要未报告具体血钾、醛固酮水平及影像学尺寸等数值。
