summary_zh: 本文描述了一例37岁女性患者检出原发性醛固酮增多症（PA）的临床病例。该患者因稳定性多形性室性心动过速（V-tach）发作而紧急入住心内科。该病例的疾病特点是PA以室性心律失常的形式突然表现，而此前患者有长期原发性高血压（EH）但无任何症状性起源体征。诊断步骤的详细梳理证实了对于心律失常患者入院时测定血钾水平的重要性。在持续性血压升高且无传统EH危险因素的情况下，电解质分析是诊断性排查的重要环节。在本病例中，检测到持续性低钾血症，而病史中无可能导致电解质紊乱的前提条件。原发性醛固酮增多症在医学文献中描述了广泛的临床表现。本观察证实了PA不典型临床过程的可能性，并表明寻找肾上腺肿瘤作为致死性心律失常发生原因具有客观合理性。PA中的心室节律紊乱可能是严重电解质紊乱背景下发生心肌电不稳定的可能选项。在本观察中，术前期间使用胺碘酮、醛固酮拮抗剂进行药物治疗稳定了患者的病情。本临床病例展示了不同专科医生（心内科医生、内分泌科医生、泌尿外科医生）在醛固酮增多症诊断和治疗过程中的连续性，同时也考虑了需要肾上腺肿瘤手术的节律紊乱患者的心脏科支持特点。

title: Ectopic activity and β-adrenergic reactivity of erythrocyte membranes in children with ventricular arrhythmia after radiofrequency ablation: a pilot observational study
summary: Background. Ventricular arrhythmias (VA) in children are characterized by a high recurrence rate after radiofrequency ablation (RFA). Given the important role of autonomic dysregulation in arrhythmogenesis, the erythrocyte membrane β-adrenergic reactivity (β-ARM), reflecting β-adrenergic receptor desensitization, can be used to personalize approaches to the management of pediatric patients. Aim: To analyze the relationship between residual ectopic activity (EA) and VA recurrence in children before, on the third day, and in the late period after RFA with β-ARM levels. Material and Methods. Ten patients aged 9–17 years with VA (EA >10%) were included. β-ARM levels and the presence of ventricular extrasystoles (VEPs) based on Holter ECG monitoring were determined before RFA, on the third day, and 6–18 months after RFA. One obese patient was excluded from the β-ARM analysis. Results. Recurrent VEPs (≥10%) were recorded in 2 patients (20%), with residual activity <10% in 2 patients (20%). Visually, the baseline β-ARM was lower in patients without recurrence. Early changes in β-ARM were chaotic (influence of stress, anesthesia). In the late period, two zones were identified: ≤8.97 conventional units (absence of VEPs, n=5) and ≥13.68 conventional units (residual activity 5–19%, n=4). A statistically significant reduction in β-ARM was observed only in the group without VES (p=0.043). Conclusion. Low preoperative β-ARM is associated with a favorable outcome, and long-term zonation and reduction in patients free of recurrence confirm the reversibility of sympathetic hyperactivation. β-ARM can be used to personalize follow-up care in children after RFA.

title: Pacemaker Dependency in Patients Undergoing Implantation of Dual-chamber Devices After Alcohol Septum Ablation: A Retrospective Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Patients with hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (HOCM) undergoing alcohol septal ablation (ASA) are at risk for high-degree atrioventricular (AV) block, often requiring permanent pacemaker (PPM) implantation. However, long-term pacemaker dependency in this population remains unclear.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed HOCM patients who underwent ASA and subsequent implantation of a cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) due to procedure-related AV block between 2016 and 2023. CIED interrogation at ≥ 6 weeks postimplantation was used to assess ventricular pacing (VP). Pacemaker dependency was defined as > 1% VP. Associations with baseline characteristics were examined using logistic regression.

RESULTS: Of 464 patients undergoing ASA, 95 (20.5%) received a CIED, and 67 were available for follow-up. Only 30 patients (44.8%) showed > 1% VP; 9 (13.4%) were completely dependent (100% VP). In contrast, 31 patients (46.3%) had ≤ 0.1% VP. Persistent AV block was more common in patients with preinterventional left bundle branch block. Intraprocedural AV block showed a trend toward persistent pacemaker dependency.

CONCLUSIONS: In this cohort, long-term pacemaker dependency after ASA was unexpectedly low. These findings suggest that AV conduction may recover in a significant proportion of patients, raising the question of whether some may safely avoid PPM implantation. Larger prospective studies are needed to guide device therapy decisions in this population. Our findings challenge the assumption of permanent AV block after ASA and suggest reconsidering routine early device implantation in selected patients.

AI.motivation: HOCM患者接受酒精室间隔消融（ASA）后存在发生高度房室（AV）阻滞的风险，常需植入永久起搏器（PPM），但该人群长期起搏器依赖情况尚不明确，影响器械治疗决策。
AI.method: 回顾性分析2016-2023年接受ASA并因手术相关AV阻滞植入心脏植入式电子设备（CIED）的HOCM患者。植入后≥6周进行CIED程控评估心室起搏（VP）比例，起搏器依赖定义为VP>1%。采用logistic回归分析基线特征与起搏器依赖的关联。
AI.result: 464例接受ASA的患者中，95例（20.5%）植入CIED，67例可随访。仅30例（44.8%）VP>1%，9例（13.4%）完全依赖（VP 100%）；31例（46.3%）VP≤0.1%。术前左束支传导阻滞患者持续性AV阻滞更常见；术中AV阻滞与持续性起搏器依赖呈趋势。
AI.conclusion: 本队列中ASA术后长期起搏器依赖率意外偏低，提示相当比例患者AV传导可恢复，对术后永久性AV阻滞的假设提出挑战，部分患者或可安全避免PPM植入。需更大规模前瞻性研究指导器械治疗决策，局限性为回顾性设计、样本量有限。

title: Harmonised and Traceable Medical Metrology Infrastructure for Safe and Reliable Healthcare in Europe
summary: Ensuring reliable performance of critical medical electrical equipment requires regular calibration, yet the devices such as electrocardiographs (ECG), electroencephalographs (EEG), electrosurgical units (ESU), and defibrillators still lack of compatible measurement methods and robust metrological traceability. Medical electrical signals variability, strongly affected by factors like bioimpedance, further challenges accurate evaluation. To tackle these issues, the EPM EURAMET 25HLT08 Met4MED project aims at developing novel metrology to provide improved traceability in this field. The project will also create a metrological framework utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the accuracy of key parameters in medical equipment, while adopting an open-source approach to maximize its impact.

AI.tldr: 欧洲Met4MED项目旨在为心电图机、脑电图机、电外科设备和除颤器等医疗电气设备开发可溯源计量方法，并利用人工智能提升关键参数准确性。
AI.motivation: 心电图机、脑电图机、电外科设备和除颤器等关键医疗电气设备缺乏兼容的测量方法和稳健的计量溯源，且生物阻抗等因素导致信号变异大，影响设备性能的准确评估。
AI.method: EPM EURAMET 25HLT08 Met4MED项目，旨在开发新型计量方法以改善该领域的溯源，并建立利用人工智能提升医疗设备关键参数准确性的计量框架，采用开源方式推广。摘要未报告具体研究对象、样本量、终点定义或统计方法。

title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Long-Term Mortality in Patients with Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators
summary: Aims: Accurate prediction of the clinical course in implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) and cardiac resynchronization therapy-defibrillator (CRT-D) patients is crucial, as their disease progression varies significantly due to comorbidities and individual characteristics. Methods: This retrospective study included 3321 patients from four hospitals in China, with 3207 for model development and internal validation and 114 for external testing. Five machine learning (ML) models were evaluated using the C-index, time-dependent AUROC, and Brier score. Decision curve analysis (DCA) assessed clinical utility, while Kaplan–Meier curves stratified patients into high-, intermediate-, and low-risk groups. SHAP analysis identified key predictors and explained model outputs. Results: The Random Survival Forest (RSF) model demonstrated favorable numerical performance across multiple evaluation metrics, achieving the highest time-dependent AUROC (0.74, 0.74) and C-index (0.71, 0.70) in internal and external test sets. It also had the lowest time-dependent Brier score (0.17) in the internal test and ranked second (0.13) in the external test. DCA demonstrated numerically higher net benefit for the RSF model across evaluated threshold probabilities. Kaplan–Meier curves revealed distinct survival trajectories, with high-risk patients showing significantly higher mortality than low-risk patients (HR: 4.50, 95% CI: 3.10–6.55, p < 0.0001), while intermediate-risk patients also had increased mortality (HR: 2.49, 95% CI: 1.69–3.68, p < 0.0001). LVEDD was the most influential predictor of mortality. Conclusions: The RSF survival model enables individualized, time-resolved prediction of all-cause mortality risk in ICD and CRT-D patients, supporting risk stratification and future evaluation of clinical utility, while requiring cautious interpretation of longer-term predictions due to limited numbers at risk.

title: [Leadless pacemakers : current evidence and future perspectives].
summary: Leadless pacemakers represent a major advance in cardiac pacing. Unlike conventional systems, they are entirely implanted within the heart, without transvenous leads or a subcutaneous generator, thereby substantially reducing the risks of infection, lead fracture, and device displacement. First introduced in 2012 with the Nanostim™ (St. Jude Medical®), this technology subsequently evolved with the market introduction of the Micra™ (Medtronic®), which is easy to implant and has a safety profile comparable to that of conventional pacemakers. More recently, the AVEIR™ system (Abbott's®) has marked a further milestone by enabling leadless dual-chamber pacing with direct «implant-to-implant» communication between the atrial and ventricular modules. This evolution paves the way for more complex leadless pacing strategies comparable to conventional systems. In addition, this latest model allows device retrieval and repositioning, overcoming some of the limitations of earlier generations.

title: Generation and Functional Characterization of Cadaver-Derived iPSC-Cardiomyocytes: A Feasibility Study Toward Functional Molecular Autopsy in Sudden Cardiac Death
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) accounts for a substantial share of deaths in young individuals. Despite postmortem pathological, toxicological, and forensic examination and molecular autopsy, many cases remain unexplained, highlighting the need for complementary approaches to investigate the functional consequences of genetic variants identified after death. In this study, we describe a methodology for generating cardiomyocytes from human cadavers and demonstrate their functional viability. Achilles tendons were harvested from seven cadavers, all younger than 40 years of age, that had been preserved in a morgue and were subject to forensic autopsies. Fibroblasts were successfully cultured in six cases and reprogrammed into cadaver-derived induced pluripotent stem cells (CdiPSCs) in three cases. The CdiPSCs exhibited a stable pluripotent phenotype and were differentiated into cardiomyocytes (CdiPSC-CMs) positive for cardiac markers. Electrophysiological and optical characterization demonstrated functional cellular properties, including spontaneous and evoked action potentials, voltage-gated sodium currents, calcium wave propagation, and re-entrant rotor activity. CdiPSC-CMs also responded to β-adrenergic stimulation, demonstrating preservation of key excitable and signaling properties. Together, these findings establish the technical feasibility of recovering viable and functionally responsive cardiomyocytes from individuals post-death. This study provides a proof-of-concept platform for future functional studies of patient-specific genetic variants identified by molecular autopsy and, ultimately, for assessing their potential pathogenicity.

AI.tldr: 从7例尸检者跟腱培养成纤维细胞，3例成功重编程为iPSC并分化为心肌细胞，证实死后心肌细胞功能研究可行。
AI.motivation: 年轻个体猝死中部分病例经尸检和分子 autopsy 仍无法解释，需补充方法评估死后所发现遗传变异的功能后果。

summary_zh:
背景：心源性猝死（SCD）在年轻人死亡中占相当大的比例。尽管进行了死后病理学、毒理学和法医学检查以及分子尸检，许多病例仍无法解释，这凸显了需要补充方法来研究死后发现的遗传变异的功能后果。

目的：在本研究中，我们描述了一种从人类尸体生成心肌细胞的方法，并证明了其功能活力。

方法：从七具尸体（均小于40岁）中获取跟腱，这些尸体保存在太平间并接受了法医尸检。在六例中成功培养成纤维细胞，并在三例中重编程为尸体来源的诱导多能干细胞（CdiPSCs）。CdiPSCs表现出稳定的多能表型，并分化为心肌细胞（CdiPSC-CMs），对心脏标志物呈阳性。

结果：电生理和光学表征显示了功能性细胞特性，包括自发和诱发的动作电位、电压门控钠电流、钙波传播和折返转子活动。CdiPSC-CMs还对β-肾上腺素能刺激有反应，表明关键兴奋性和信号传导特性得以保留。

结论：总之，这些发现确立了从死后个体中恢复有活力且功能响应的心肌细胞的技术可行性。本研究为未来对分子尸检识别的患者特异性遗传变异进行功能研究，并最终评估其潜在致病性提供了一个概念验证平台。

title: Multichannel Dysfunction Associated With a Dominant-Negative KCNH2 Missense Variant, p.G604S, Results in Action Potential Duration Prolongation and Early Afterdepolarizations in a Patient-Specific, Reengineered Cardiomyocyte Model of Type 2 Long-QT Syndrome.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Type 2 long-QT syndrome results from KCNH2-encoded Kv11.1 loss-of-function, but whether secondary inward-current dysfunction amplifies dysfunction remains unclear.

METHODS: We characterized sodium (SCN5A, INa) and L-type calcium channel (CACNA1C, ICa) function in KCNH2-G604S and variant-corrected isogenic control induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (iPSC-CMs). Whole-cell patch-clamp measured action potential duration at 90% repolarization (APD90), and potassium (IKr), sodium (INa), and calcium (ICa, L) currents. Fluo-4 imaging quantified calcium transients. A modified Kernik-Clancy iPSC-CM model incorporated experimentally measured persistent INa,L and ICa,L fractions and simulated isolated and combined current defects.

RESULTS: KCNH2-G604S caused severe IKr loss-of-function (72.5% reduction). APD90 was prolonged in G604S-iPSC-CMs (765±58 ms) compared with isogenic controls (368±37 ms; P<0.005), with early afterdepolarizations in 50% of G604S cells. Nifedipine, verapamil, and mexiletine successfully shortened APD90 and abolished early afterdepolarizations. Compared with isogenic control, INa,L (0.60±0.1% versus 0.26±0.06%; P<0.01), persistent ICa,L (2.88±0.55% versus 1.26±0.35%; P<0.05), and calcium transient decay times (P<0.0001) were greater in G604S iPSC-CMs. Increased persistent ICa,L was phenocopied by E-4031 in isogenic controls and reduced by nifedipine in G604S iPSC-CMs. In silico modeling revealed that the IKr defect alone prolonged APD90 to only 620 ms. The addition of the observed INa,L defect had a small additive effect (+20 ms); however, incorporating persistent ICa,L synergistically extended APD90 to 758 ms, replicating the experimental phenotype. Flux dynamics analysis indicated that this persistent Ca2+ entry suppresses the forward-mode sodium-calcium exchanger, forcing a compensatory reliance on sarcoplasmic-endoplasmic reticulum Ca-ATPase that primes for calcium instability.

CONCLUSIONS: The KCNH2-G604S variant drives a severe multihit phenotype via primary IKr loss-of-function and secondary state-dependent gain-of-function in persistent ICa,L. These comprehensive validations demonstrate that the remodeled persistent ICa,L acts as the essential amplifier driving extreme action potential duration prolongation and Ca2+ mishandling.

AI.tldr: 在KCNH2-G604S iPSC-CMs中，IKr严重缺失合并持续性ICa,L增益导致APD显著延长和早期后除极，钙通道阻滞剂可逆转。
AI.motivation: 2型长QT综合征由KCNH2编码的Kv11.1功能缺失引起，但继发性内向电流功能障碍是否放大异常尚不明确，本研究旨在探究多通道功能障碍在疾病表型中的作用。
AI.method: 研究采用患者特异性iPSC-CMs及变异校正的同基因对照，全细胞膜片钳测量APD90及IKr、INa、ICa,L电流，Fluo-4成像检测钙瞬变，并利用改良Kernik-Clancy模型模拟单独及联合电流缺陷。
AI.result: G604S导致IKr降低72.5%，APD90延长至765±58 ms（对照368±37 ms，P<0.005），50%细胞出现EAD。INa,L（0.60±0.1% vs 0.26±0.06%，P<0.01）和持续性ICa,L（2.88±0.55% vs 1.26±0.35%，P<0.05）增加，钙瞬变衰减时间延长（P<0.0001）。硝苯地平、维拉帕米和美西律缩短APD90并消除EAD。模拟显示IKr缺陷单独使APD90延长至620 ms，加入INa,L缺陷小幅增加20 ms，而纳入持续性ICa,L协同延长至758 ms，重现实验表型。
AI.conclusion: KCNH2-G604S通过原发性IKr功能缺失和继发性持续性ICa,L增益驱动多通道功能障碍，持续性ICa,L是APD过度延长和钙处理异常的关键放大因素，提示钙通道阻滞剂可能成为治疗策略，但需进一步临床验证。

summary_zh:
背景：2型长QT综合征由KCNH2编码的Kv11.1功能丧失所致，但继发性内向电流功能障碍是否放大功能障碍仍不清楚。

方法：我们在KCNH2-G604S和变异校正的同基因对照诱导多能干细胞来源心肌细胞（iPSC-CMs）中表征了钠通道（SCN5A，INa）和L型钙通道（CACNA1C，ICa）功能。全细胞膜片钳测量了复极90%时的动作电位时程（APD90），以及钾电流（IKr）、钠电流（INa）和钙电流（ICa，L）。Fluo-4成像定量了钙瞬变。改良的Kernik-Clancy iPSC-CM模型纳入了实验测量的持续性INa,L和ICa,L分数，并模拟了单独和联合电流缺陷。

结果：KCNH2-G604S导致严重的IKr功能丧失（减少72.5%）。与同基因对照（368±37 ms；P<0.005）相比，G604S-iPSC-CMs的APD90延长（765±58 ms），50%的G604S细胞出现早期后除极。硝苯地平、维拉帕米和美西律成功缩短了APD90并消除了早期后除极。与同基因对照相比，G604S iPSC-CMs中INa,L（0.60±0.1% vs 0.26±0.06%；P<0.01）、持续性ICa,L（2.88±0.55% vs 1.26±0.35%；P<0.05）和钙瞬变衰减时间（P<0.0001）更大。持续性ICa,L增加在E-4031处理的同基因对照中被表型模拟，并在G604S iPSC-CMs中被硝苯地平减少。计算机模拟显示，单独IKr缺陷仅将APD90延长至620 ms。加入观察到的INa,L缺陷具有小的叠加效应（+20 ms）；然而，纳入持续性ICa,L协同性地将APD90延长至758 ms，复制了实验表型。通量动力学分析表明，这种持续性Ca2+内流抑制了正向模式钠钙交换体，迫使代偿性依赖肌浆网-内质网Ca-ATP酶，从而引发钙不稳定。

结论：KCNH2-G604S变异通过原发性IKr功能丧失和继发性持续性ICa,L的状态依赖性功能获得，驱动了严重的多发性打击表型。这些全面的验证表明，重塑的持续性ICa,L作为关键放大器，驱动了极端的动作电位时程延长和Ca2+处理异常。

title: Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)-Based Genome Editing in Inherited Cardiovascular Diseases: Therapeutic Advances, Emerging Editing Platforms, and Translational Challenges.
summary: Inherited cardiovascular diseases (ICVDs) are a broad category of hereditary disorders resulting from pathogenic mutations that alter cardiac anatomy, electrical conduction, and metabolic pathways. The main types include hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), cardiac channelopathies, and familial hypercholesterolemia (FH) and are associated with heart failure, malignant arrhythmias, and sudden cardiac death, particularly in young people. Current treatments, such as pharmacological therapies, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, and heart transplantation, have significantly improved outcomes; however, these treatments are mainly targeted toward symptom control and the prevention of complications without correcting the underlying genetic defects. Recent advancements in genome editing have transformed precision cardiovascular care, with clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR)-based technologies emerging as potential methods for targeting and modifying disease-causing variants. Emerging platforms, such as base editing, prime editing, and epigenome editing, have widened the therapeutic potential of genome engineering by enhancing editing precision and reducing some of the constraints of the traditional CRISPR-Cas9 strategy. In the setting of inherited cardiovascular disorders, promising early results have been obtained in preclinical studies using human induced pluripotent stem cell and animal models, including correction of MYBPC3 and MYH7 mutations in HCM; targeting of TTN-, RBM20-, and LMNA-associated mechanisms in DCM; restoration of ion channel function in inherited arrhythmia syndromes; and modulation of lipid-related genes such as PCSK9, LDLR, and ANGPTL3 in FH. However, major challenges remain, including off-target effects, effective delivery to cardiac tissues, immunological responses, interpretation of genetic variants, and ethical concerns. This review provides a translational, integrated view of the evolution of CRISPR-based genome editing technologies, their application to ICVDs, current preclinical and clinical advances, and the challenges that need to be addressed to achieve safe and effective translation into cardiovascular therapeutics.

AI.tldr: CRISPR及其衍生编辑平台在遗传性心血管病临床前模型中显示纠正致病突变的潜力，但脱靶效应、心脏递送和免疫原性等转化障碍尚未解决。
AI.motivation: 遗传性心血管病（包括肥厚型心肌病、扩张型心肌病、心脏离子通道病和家族性高胆固醇血症）由致病突变引起，现有药物、ICD和心脏移植仅控制症状和预防并发症，无法纠正遗传缺陷，亟需从根源干预的精准治疗策略。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，整合CRISPR基因组编辑技术（含碱基编辑、先导编辑和表观基因组编辑）在遗传性心血管病中的应用证据，梳理人诱导多能干细胞和动物模型的临床前研究结果，并讨论转化挑战；摘要未报告系统检索策略、样本量或定量统计方法。
AI.result: 临床前研究显示：在HCM模型中可纠正MYBPC3和MYH7突变；在DCM中靶向TTN、RBM20和LMNA相关机制；在遗传性心律失常综合征中恢复离子通道功能；在FH中调控PCSK9、LDLR和ANGPTL3等脂质相关基因。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。主要挑战包括脱靶效应、心脏组织有效递送、免疫反应、基因变异解读和伦理问题。
AI.conclusion: CRISPR碱基编辑、先导编辑和表观基因组编辑为遗传性心血管病提供了从症状控制转向病因纠正的可能，但当前证据限于临床前模型，安全有效的临床转化仍需解决递送、脱靶和免疫原性等关键问题，尚不能改变电生理临床实践。

summary_zh: 遗传性心血管疾病（ICVDs）是一大类由致病突变引起的遗传性疾病，这些突变改变心脏解剖结构、电传导和代谢通路。主要类型包括肥厚型心肌病（HCM）、扩张型心肌病（DCM）、心脏离子通道病和家族性高胆固醇血症（FH），并与心力衰竭、恶性心律失常和心脏性猝死相关，尤其是在年轻人中。当前的治疗方法，如药物治疗、植入式心律转复除颤器和心脏移植，已显著改善预后；然而，这些治疗主要针对症状控制和并发症预防，并未纠正潜在的遗传缺陷。基因组编辑的最新进展已改变精准心血管护理，基于成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列（CRISPR）的技术 emerging 作为靶向和修改致病变异的潜在方法。新兴平台，如碱基编辑、先导编辑和表观基因组编辑，通过提高编辑精度和减少传统CRISPR-Cas9策略的一些限制，拓宽了基因组工程的治疗潜力。在遗传性心血管疾病背景下，使用人类诱导多能干细胞和动物模型的临床前研究已获得有希望的早期结果，包括纠正HCM中的MYBPC3和MYH7突变；靶向DCM中TTN-、RBM20-和LMNA相关机制；恢复遗传性心律失常综合征中的离子通道功能；以及调节FH中脂质相关基因如PCSK9、LDLR和ANGPTL3。然而，仍存在重大挑战，包括脱靶效应、有效递送至心脏组织、免疫反应、遗传变异解读和伦理问题。本综述提供了基于CRISPR的基因组编辑技术演变、其在ICVDs中的应用、当前临床前和临床进展以及实现安全有效转化为心血管治疗所需解决的挑战的转化性、综合性视角。

title: KCNJ2 gene spontaneous missense mutation in a child with Andersen-Tawil syndrome: a case report
summary: Background Andersen-Tawil syndrome (ATS) is a rare disorder featuring ventricular arrhythmias, periodic paralysis, and skeletal anomalies. KCNJ2 mutations account for about 70% of cases. We report a child with a novel KCNJ2 mutation and subclinical hypothyroidism, an association not previously described. Case presentation A 10-year-old boy presented with episodic limb weakness, palpitations, low-set ears, and bilateral fifth-finger bending. Labs showed spontaneous normokalemia without potassium supplementation, elevated creatine kinase, and subclinical hypothyroidism. ECG revealed frequent ventricular premature beats. Genetic testing identified a heterozygous KCNJ2 c.461G > A (p.C154Y) mutation, confirmed as de novo . Results The patient was treated with propafenone and acetazolamide. At six months, paralytic episodes decreased from weekly to one mild event, and premature beats reduced markedly on Holter. No adverse effects occurred. Conclusion This case expands the KCNJ2 mutation spectrum and suggests thyroid screening may be considered in ATS. With proper treatment, short-term prognosis is favorable.

AI.tldr: 一例10岁Andersen-Tawil综合征患儿携带新发KCNJ2 c.461G>A（p.C154Y）杂合突变，并合并亚临床甲状腺功能减退，经普罗帕酮和乙酰唑胺治疗后短期预后良好。
AI.motivation: Andersen-Tawil综合征（ATS）是一种以室性心律失常、周期性麻痹和骨骼异常为特征的罕见疾病，约70%的病例由KCNJ2基因突变引起。既往文献中未见ATS合并亚临床甲状腺功能减退的报道，本病例报告旨在扩展KCNJ2突变谱并提示甲状腺筛查的必要性。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为一名10岁男孩，表现为发作性肢体无力、心悸、低位耳及双侧第五指弯曲。实验室检查显示自发性正常血钾（未补钾）、肌酸激酶升高及亚临床甲状腺功能减退。心电图显示频发室性早搏。基因检测发现KCNJ2 c.461G>A（p.C154Y）杂合突变，并经家系验证为新发突变。治疗采用普罗帕酮和乙酰唑胺，随访6个月。
AI.result: 治疗后6个月，麻痹发作频率从每周发作减少至仅1次轻微事件，动态心电图显示室性早搏显著减少。治疗期间未发生不良反应。摘要未报告具体的早搏数量变化及统计学检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 本病例扩展了KCNJ2基因突变谱，并提示对ATS患者可考虑进行甲状腺功能筛查。经普罗帕酮和乙酰唑胺治疗，短期预后良好。但作为单例报告，结论的外推性有限，需更多研究验证。

summary_zh: 背景：Andersen-Tawil 综合征（ATS）是一种罕见疾病，以室性心律失常、周期性麻痹和骨骼异常为特征。KCNJ2 突变约占病例的 70%。我们报告一名携带新发 KCNJ2 突变并伴有亚临床甲状腺功能减退症的儿童，这种关联此前未见描述。病例介绍：一名 10 岁男孩表现为发作性肢体无力、心悸、低位耳和双侧第五指弯曲。实验室检查显示在未补钾情况下自发性血钾正常、肌酸激酶升高和亚临床甲状腺功能减退症。心电图显示频发室性期前收缩。基因检测发现杂合 KCNJ2 c.461G > A（p.C154Y）突变，确认为新发突变。结果：患者接受普罗帕酮和乙酰唑胺治疗。六个月时，麻痹发作从每周一次减少至一次轻微事件，动态心电图显示期前收缩显著减少。未发生不良反应。结论：本病例扩展了 KCNJ2 突变谱，并提示 ATS 患者可考虑甲状腺筛查。经过适当治疗，短期预后良好。

title: Network toxicology, machine learning, single-cell analysis, and molecular docking reveal 6PPD/6PPD-Q-associated atrial fibrillation signatures
summary: Introduction Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most prevalent sustained arrhythmia worldwide, and environmental factors are increasingly recognized as contributors to its complex pathogenesis. The tire antioxidant N-(1,3-dimethylbutyl)-N'-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine (6PPD) and its oxidation product 6PPD-quinone (6PPD-Q) are emerging environmental contaminants with reported cardiotoxicity; however, their molecular relationship with AF remains unclear.Objectives This study aimed to identify potential molecular targets and pathways that link 6PPD/6PPD-Q exposure to AF using an integrated network toxicology and machine learning strategy.Methods Multicohort atrial microarray datasets from patients with AF were integrated to identify AF-related genes using differential expression analysis, weighted gene coexpression network analysis, and GeneCards database screening. Putative targets of 6PPD/6PPD-Q were predicted using multiple in silico databases and intersected with AF-related genes. Network toxicology, enrichment analysis, machine learning with SHAP interpretation, single-cell RNA sequencing, and molecular docking were utilized to identify and characterize hub genes. Key targets were validated using qRT-PCR and western blotting in human cardiac fibroblasts. A mouse exposure model was further used to assess AF inducibility, duration, and cardiac gene expression in vivo.Results Sixteen putative AF-associated target genes of 6PPD/6PPD-Q were identified. Machine learning analysis highlighted four hub genes as key candidate hubs. Single-cell RNA analysis revealed cell type-specific expression, with enrichment in cardiomyocytes and vascular structural cells. Molecular docking predicted favorable binding interactions between 6PPD/6PPD-Q and the key target proteins. In vitro exposure to 6PPD or 6PPD-Q at the tested concentrations upregulated the mRNA and protein levels of all four candidate genes. In vivo exposure significantly increased pacing-induced AF inducibility, prolonged AF duration, and upregulated the expression of all these genes in cardiac tissues.Conclusion These findings suggest that 6PPD and 6PPD-Q may contribute to AF by targeting specific genes and signaling pathways, with DDR1, BCHE, HTR2B, and KCNJ3 identified as core exposure-related hubs.

AI.tldr: 环境污染物6PPD/6PPD-Q通过靶向DDR1、BCHE、HTR2B和KCNJ3等核心基因，可能促进心房颤动的发生，动物实验证实暴露增加AF可诱发性并延长持续时间。
AI.motivation: 心房颤动（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常，环境因素在其复杂发病机制中的作用日益受到重视。轮胎抗氧化剂6PPD及其氧化产物6PPD-Q是新兴环境污染物，已知具有心脏毒性，但其与AF的分子关联尚不明确。本研究旨在识别连接6PPD/6PPD-Q暴露与AF的潜在分子靶点和通路。
AI.method: 研究整合多个AF患者心房微阵列数据集，通过差异表达分析、加权基因共表达网络分析和GeneCards数据库筛选识别AF相关基因。利用多个计算机数据库预测6PPD/6PPD-Q的潜在靶点，并与AF相关基因取交集。采用网络毒理学、富集分析、机器学习（SHAP解释）、单细胞RNA测序和分子对接识别和表征核心基因。在人心脏成纤维细胞中通过qRT-PCR和western blotting验证关键靶点。进一步使用小鼠暴露模型评估AF可诱发性、持续时间和心脏基因表达。
AI.result: 共识别出16个6PPD/6PPD-Q的 putative AF相关靶基因。机器学习分析突出四个核心基因作为关键候选枢纽。单细胞RNA分析揭示细胞类型特异性表达，在心肌细胞和血管结构细胞中富集。分子对接预测6PPD/6PPD-Q与关键靶蛋白具有良好结合相互作用。体外暴露于测试浓度的6PPD或6PPD-Q上调所有四个候选基因的mRNA和蛋白水平。体内暴露显著增加起搏诱导的AF可诱发性、延长AF持续时间，并上调心脏组织中所有这些基因的表达。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明6PPD和6PPD-Q可能通过靶向特定基因和信号通路促进AF，其中DDR1、BCHE、HTR2B和KCNJ3被确定为暴露相关的核心枢纽。这些发现提示环境污染物在AF发病中的潜在作用，为AF的环境风险因素提供了分子证据，但需进一步临床研究验证。

summary_zh:
引言 心房颤动（AF）是全球最常见的持续性心律失常，环境因素日益被认为是其复杂发病机制的贡献因素。轮胎抗氧化剂N-(1,3-二甲基丁基)-N'-苯基对苯二胺（6PPD）及其氧化产物6PPD-醌（6PPD-Q）是新兴的环境污染物，据报道具有心脏毒性；然而，它们与AF的分子关系仍不清楚。

目的 本研究旨在利用整合的网络毒理学和机器学习策略，识别将6PPD/6PPD-Q暴露与AF联系起来的潜在分子靶点和通路。

方法 整合来自AF患者的多队列心房微阵列数据集，通过差异表达分析、加权基因共表达网络分析和GeneCards数据库筛选来识别AF相关基因。使用多个计算机数据库预测6PPD/6PPD-Q的推定靶点，并与AF相关基因取交集。利用网络毒理学、富集分析、带有SHAP解释的机器学习、单细胞RNA测序和分子对接来识别和表征枢纽基因。关键靶点在人心脏成纤维细胞中使用qRT-PCR和western blotting进行验证。进一步使用小鼠暴露模型评估体内AF可诱导性、持续时间和心脏基因表达。

结果 识别出16个推定的6PPD/6PPD-Q相关AF靶基因。机器学习分析突出四个枢纽基因作为关键候选枢纽。单细胞RNA分析揭示了细胞类型特异性表达，在心肌细胞和血管结构细胞中富集。分子对接预测6PPD/6PPD-Q与关键靶蛋白之间具有良好的结合相互作用。在测试浓度下，体外暴露于6PPD或6PPD-Q上调了所有四个候选基因的mRNA和蛋白质水平。体内暴露显著增加了起搏诱导的AF可诱导性，延长了AF持续时间，并上调了心脏组织中所有这些基因的表达。

结论 这些发现表明，6PPD和6PPD-Q可能通过靶向特定基因和信号通路促进AF，其中DDR1、BCHE、HTR2B和KCNJ3被确定为核心暴露相关枢纽。

title: Inter-Lead RRI Agreement Between Lead I and Lead II Across Diagnostic ECG Categories: Pilot Evidence for Wearable HRV Monitoring
summary: Background: Wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) devices capable of recording a single-lead signal—typically Lead I—have proliferated rapidly, enabling long-term ambulatory cardiac monitoring outside clinical settings. However, the extent to which Lead I-derived heart rate variability (HRV) metrics are concordant with those obtained from the clinical gold standards—12-lead ECG and 3-channel Holter monitoring—remains incompletely characterised. Methods: We analysed RR-interval series extracted from (i) the PTB-XL large-scale publicly available 12-lead ECG dataset (n = 18,869 patients; 100 Hz, 10 s recordings) and (ii) ambulatory 3-channel Holter ECG recordings (Suzuken Pico303) from four participants (two elderly adults and two young adults). Pan–Tompkins R-wave detection was applied uniformly. Time-domain (SDNN, RMSSD, and pNN50), Poincaré (SD1 and SD2), and Bland–Altman agreement metrics were computed for Lead I versus Lead II comparisons. Results: Analysis of 300 PTB-XL records (a contiguous pilot subset: records 00040–00350) stratified by diagnostic superclass revealed strong Lead I–Lead II RRI concordance for normal ECGs (NORM: r = 0.844, ICC(2,1) = 0.841, mean bias = −1.4 ms, 95% LoA [−52.4, +49.7] ms; n = 179 records) and progressively lower agreement in pathological categories (MI: r = 0.659, ICC = 0.663; CD: r = 0.433, ICC = 0.484; HYP: r = 0.556, ICC = 0.574; STTC: r = 0.635, ICC = 0.634). Holter Pico303 recordings demonstrated significant inter-individual variability; SDNN ranged from 37.0 ms (elderly male) to 80.8 ms (elderly female) and 80.4 ms (young male), while RMSSD ranged from 27.0 to 68.0 ms. R-wave amplitude was systematically higher in Lead II (0.734 ± 0.413 mV) than Lead I (0.667 ± 0.339 mV) across the 300-record cohort (overall mean). Conclusions: Single-lead (Lead I) ECG provides HRV information comparable to Lead II for time-domain metrics, supporting the utility of wearable single-lead ECG for RRI estimation and time-domain HRV monitoring; however, systematic differences in R-wave morphology warrant lead-specific calibration of automated detection algorithms.

AI.tldr: 在正常心电图中，单导联（I导联）与II导联的RR间期及HRV时域指标一致性良好，但病理心电图一致性下降，提示可穿戴单导联设备需按导联校准。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴单导联（多为I导联）心电图快速普及，但I导联衍生的HRV指标与临床金标准（12导联心电图、3通道Holter）之间的一致性尚不明确，缺乏按诊断类别分层的证据。
AI.method: 研究分析两部分数据：PTB-XL公开12导联心电图数据集（共18869例，100 Hz、10 s记录）中连续选取的300份记录（编号00040–00350），按诊断大类分层；以及4名受试者（2名老年、2名青年）的3通道Holter（Suzuken Pico303）记录。统一采用Pan–Tompkins法检测R波，比较I导联与II导联的RR间期，计算时域指标（SDNN、RMSSD、pNN50）、Poincaré指标（SD1、SD2）及Bland–Altman一致性。
AI.result: 正常心电图（NORM，n=179）I、II导联RR间期一致性良好：r=0.844，ICC(2,1)=0.841，平均偏差−1.4 ms，95%一致性界限[−52.4, +49.7] ms；病理类别一致性依次降低：MI r=0.659、ICC=0.663，CD r=0.433、ICC=0.484，HYP r=0.556、ICC=0.574，STTC r=0.635、ICC=0.634。Holter记录个体间差异明显，SDNN 37.0–80.8 ms，RMSSD 27.0–68.0 ms。300份记录中II导联R波振幅（0.734±0.413 mV）系统性高于I导联（0.667±0.339 mV）。
AI.conclusion: 单导联（I导联）心电图在时域HRV指标上可提供与II导联相近的信息，支持可穿戴单导联设备用于RR间期估计和时域HRV监测；但病理心电图一致性下降及R波形态的系统性差异，要求自动检测算法按导联进行校准。本研究为试点性质，样本量小且Holter仅4例，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh: 背景：能够记录单导联信号（通常为导联I）的可穿戴心电图（ECG）设备迅速普及，使得在临床环境之外进行长期动态心脏监测成为可能。然而，导联I衍生的心率变异性（HRV）指标与临床金标准——12导联ECG和3通道Holter监测——所获得的指标的一致程度仍未完全明确。方法：我们分析了从（i）PTB-XL大规模公开12导联ECG数据集（n = 18,869名患者；100 Hz，10秒记录）和（ii）来自四名参与者（两名老年人和两名年轻人）的动态3通道Holter ECG记录（Suzuken Pico303）中提取的RR间期序列。统一应用Pan–Tompkins R波检测。计算了导联I与导联II比较的时域（SDNN、RMSSD和pNN50）、Poincaré（SD1和SD2）和Bland–Altman一致性指标。结果：对300份PTB-XL记录（连续试点子集：记录00040–00350）按诊断超类分层分析显示，正常ECG的导联I–导联II RRI一致性很强（NORM：r = 0.844，ICC(2,1) = 0.841，平均偏差 = −1.4 ms，95% LoA [−52.4, +49.7] ms；n = 179份记录），而在病理类别中一致性逐渐降低（MI：r = 0.659，ICC = 0.663；CD：r = 0.433，ICC = 0.484；HYP：r = 0.556，ICC = 0.574；STTC：r = 0.635，ICC = 0.634）。Holter Pico303记录显示出显著的个体间变异性；SDNN范围从37.0 ms（老年男性）到80.8 ms（老年女性）和80.4 ms（年轻男性），而RMSSD范围从27.0到68.0 ms。在300份记录队列中（总体均值），导联II的R波振幅（0.734 ± 0.413 mV）系统性高于导联I（0.667 ± 0.339 mV）。结论：单导联（导联I）ECG在时域指标上提供了与导联II相当的HRV信息，支持可穿戴单导联ECG用于RRI估计和时域HRV监测的实用性；然而，R波形态的系统性差异需要对自动检测算法进行导联特异性校准。

title: Comparison of Electrocardiogram Interpretation Between Artificial Intelligence and Healthcare Professionals
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) is the most widely used tool to detect myocardial injury, cardiac arrhythmias, pericarditis, electrolyte disturbances, and pulmonary diseases. Clinical settings have increasingly utilized artificial intelligence (AI) in recent years. AI-ECG algorithms are being applied for ECG interpretation. The objective was to compare the ECG interpretation proficiency of GPT-5 compared to the ECG analysis of healthcare professionals. Twelve-lead ECG tracings were obtained from 25 healthy adult males (18–50 years) at rest. Lead II ECG tracings were calculated for heart rate, amplitude (P-wave and T-wave), and intervals (PR interval, QRS complex duration, and QT interval) using AI-based analytics and by healthcare professionals. Paired sample t-test was used for two-group comparison. p < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. The P-wave amplitude showed a statistically significant difference (p= 0.001), whereas for the intervals the QT interval showed a statistically significant difference (p= 0.04) between GPT-5 and health professionals. The parameters such as the heart rate, T wave amplitude and PR interval did not show any statistically significant difference between the GPT-5 and health professionals. The findings indicate that GPT-5 has its limitations but has a good overall agreement in the analysis of ECG recordings when compared to healthcare professionals.
